detail.abstract: The AFT EU Market Readiness Instrument is a decision grade diagnostic framework for small and medium sized enterprises considering entry into the European Union single market. It assesses whether a firm is ready to move towards EU market entry, where its main blockers sit, and what evidence must be produced before resources are committed. The instrument reads readiness across seven independent capabilities, calibrated to sector context through NACE Rev. 2.1. It treats confidence not as a perception score, but as evidence capacity: what a firm can demonstrate within an operationally meaningful window. The assessment resolves to one of three categorical verdicts: Go, Conditional Go or Hold. The methodology operates at the entity level. It assesses whether an individual firm is equipped to enter and operate within the single market, a layer distinct from policy level frameworks that assess market, regulatory or institutional conditions. The same architecture can also be read at cohort level for programme design, prioritisation and monitoring. This paper describes the framework’s structure and reasoning. It does not disclose calibration parameters, which remain protected. The instrument assesses readiness and risk. It does not predict commercial success.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种针对中小企业进入欧盟单一市场的决策级诊断框架——AFT欧盟市场准入准备度工具。该工具评估企业在七个独立能力维度上的准备度，输出"可进入"、"有条件进入"或"暂缓"三种结论，旨在帮助企业识别主要障碍并明确需要准备的证据，而非预测商业成功。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地评估中小企业进入欧盟单一市场的准备度，并识别其关键障碍？
AI.motivation: 中小企业进入欧盟单一市场面临复杂监管和运营要求，缺乏一个可操作的、决策级别的诊断框架来评估其实际准备状态，而非依赖主观感知或宏观政策层面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该框架基于七个独立能力维度的评估体系，将"置信度"定义为"证据能力"（即企业在运营窗口内能够展示什么），而非感知评分；评估结果分为三类判定（Go/Conditional Go/Hold），并依据NACE Rev. 2.1行业分类进行校准。
AI.method: 该工具在企业实体层面操作，评估涵盖七个能力维度，根据行业背景通过NACE Rev. 2.1进行校准，最终输出三类判定结果。框架也可用于群体层面进行项目设计、优先级排序和监测。校准参数未公开披露。
AI.findings: 该框架能够评估企业的准备度和风险，明确主要障碍所在，以及进入市场前必须提供哪些证据。但工具不预测商业成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将"置信度"重新定义为"证据能力"而非感知评分的评估逻辑；建立了企业实体层面与政策层面相区分的评估层次；提供了可同时用于个体和群体层面的诊断架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业提供了一套可操作的、决策级别的欧盟市场准入准备度诊断工具，帮助企业识别关键障碍、明确所需证据，并为项目设计、资源分配和监测提供支持。

title: Human-AI Collaboration in Strategic Decision-Making: A Systematic Review of Algorithmic Trust, Algorithmic Aversion, and Centaur Models in Digital Management
affiliations: University of Hertfordshire

detail.title: Human-AI Collaboration in Strategic Decision-Making: A Systematic Review of Algorithmic Trust, Algorithmic Aversion, and Centaur Models in Digital Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a systematic literature review of existing published research and does not involve human participants or animal subjects. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in corporate decision-making, shifting from operational automation toward strategic participation. Yet managerial adoption of AI-generated insights remains uneven, shaped by algorithmic trust, algorithmic aversion, and organisational readiness for human-AI collaboration. Objective: This systematic literature review synthesises peer-reviewed research on human-AI collaboration in strategic and managerial decision-making, with emphasis on algorithmic trust, algorithmic aversion, and Centaur (human-AI partnership) models within digital management. Method: Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, we searched Scopus (Search 1 complete; Web of Science deferred) using structured Boolean queries and backward snowballing. Thematic synthesis (Thomas & Harden, 2008) integrates findings into the Centaur Strategic Decision Framework (CSDF). Results: From 45 Scopus records, 28 studies passed full-text screening; eight seminal references and eight backward-snowball studies supplemented the corpus (36 studies synthesised). Thematic synthesis (Thomas & Harden, 2008) identified seven themes: (1) algorithmic trust antecedents (n = 31; 86%), (2) algorithmic aversion mechanisms (n = 12; 33%), (3) trust calibration and appropriate reliance (n = 27; 75%), (4) explainable AI in management (n = 7; 19%), (5) Centaur/hybrid intelligence design (n = 31; 86%), (6) strategic versus operational differences (n = 15; 42%), and (7) governance and accountability (n = 8; 22%). The Centaur Strategic Decision Framework (CSDF) integrates these themes. Conclusions: The literature confirms that human-AI collaboration at the executive level is under-researched relative to operational contexts. Future empirical work should examine trust calibration in high-stakes strategic settings using mixed-methods designs. Implications are outlined for digital management practice and doctoral research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述，基于PRISMA 2020指南对45篇Scopus记录进行主题综合，识别出7个关键主题，并整合形成半人马战略决策框架（CSDF），指出高管层面的人机协作研究仍不足于操作层面。
AI.research_question: 在战略与管理决策中，人机协作（尤其是算法信任、算法厌恶与半人马模型）的研究现状如何？
AI.motivation: 人工智能已从运营自动化转向战略参与，但管理者对AI生成见解的采纳并不均衡，受算法信任、算法厌恶和组织准备度等因素影响，亟需系统梳理相关文献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半人马战略决策框架（CSDF）、算法信任理论、算法厌恶机制、信任校准、可解释AI、人机混合智能设计
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA 2020指南，在Scopus数据库进行结构化布尔检索，辅以反向滚雪球法，最终综合36篇文献，采用Thomas & Harden (2008)的主题综合法。
AI.findings: 识别出7大主题：算法信任前因（86%）、算法厌恶机制（33%）、信任校准与适当依赖（75%）、可解释AI在管理中的应用（19%）、半人马/混合智能设计（86%）、战略与运营差异（42%）、治理与问责（22%）；整合形成CSDF框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了半人马战略决策框架（CSDF），系统整合了算法信任、算法厌恶与混合智能等理论，明确了战略决策情境下人机协作研究的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字管理实践和博士研究提供了指导，指出未来应通过混合方法设计在高风险战略情境中开展信任校准的实证研究。

title: A Real-time Power Consumption Anomaly Detection Method for Airport Terminal Baggage Handling Systems Based on the Principle of Information Entropy
affiliations: Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Real-time Power Consumption Anomaly Detection Method for Airport Terminal Baggage Handling Systems Based on the Principle of Information Entropy
detail.abstract: As the ”aorta” of modern industrial and logistics networks, material handling systems are widely used in logistics, express delivery, aviation and other industries. As a typical motor load, their power consumption accounts for a non-negligible proportion of total energy use. Abnormalities caused by equipment failures, operational deviations or management oversights can lead to energy waste in the baggage handling system (BHS). Power consumption anomaly detection for such systems is a critical support for identifying hidden resource waste and achieving energy planning objectives. However, due to the coupling effects of multiple factors, the hourly energy consumption of BHS presents obvious non-linear fluctuations, which brings great challenges to the rapid detection and accurate diagnosis of abnormal energy consumption. To address this problem, based on the BHS operation data from January 2023 to May 2026 provided by the AMES system of a large airport terminal in China, this study develops a real-time power consumption anomaly detection method based on information entropy theory and hybrid data mining technologies. The Maximal Information Coefficient (MIC) and K-means clustering algorithm are adopted to screen and extract key characteristic parameters affecting power consumption (daily passenger volume, holidays) and conduct clustering analysis, which serves as the reference for constructing the training dataset of daily information entropy calculation (January 2023 to December 2025). Combined with the K-means clustering algorithm, the demarcation point between normal and abnormal daily information entropy is determined. The range of daily hourly power consumption datasets corresponding to normal daily information entropy is regarded as the normal hourly power consumption threshold, which is used as the basis for detecting outliers in hourly power consumption data. The BHS operation data from January to May 2026 is used as the test dataset. The verification results show that the proposed daily hourly power consumption anomaly detection method, dynamically generated from historical data without subjective human intervention, has higher detection accuracy and better robustness than other common methods. The research method can provide a feasible technical path and methodological support for power consumption anomaly detection of BHS in similar airports and offer scientific reference for management departments to realize precise energy consumption control.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于信息熵理论和混合数据挖掘技术，针对行李处理系统（BHS）因多因素耦合导致的能耗非线性波动问题，提出了一种实时功率异常检测方法。该方法利用MIC和K-means聚类筛选关键特征参数，通过历史数据动态生成正常小时功率阈值，无需人工干预，检测精度和鲁棒性优于常用方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测行李处理系统（BHS）中因设备故障、操作偏差或管理疏忽导致的功率消耗异常？
AI.motivation: BHS作为现代工业与物流网络的"主动脉"，其功率消耗在总能耗中占比可观。然而，由于多因素耦合效应，BHS小时能耗呈现明显的非线性波动，传统方法难以快速、准确检测异常，亟需一种更高效、鲁棒的异常检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息熵理论、最大信息系数（MIC）、K-means聚类算法、混合数据挖掘技术
AI.method: 1. 利用MIC和K-means聚类筛选和提取关键特征参数（日旅客量、节假日）；2. 以聚类结果作为训练数据集参考，计算每日信息熵；3. 结合K-means确定正常与异常日信息熵的分界点；4. 将正常日信息熵对应的小时功率数据集范围作为正常阈值，检测小时功率异常值；5. 使用2026年1-5月数据作为测试集验证。
AI.findings: 提出的日小时功率异常检测方法由历史数据动态生成，无需主观人工干预，相比其他常见方法具有更高的检测精度和更好的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息熵理论与混合数据挖掘技术相结合，提出了一种无需主观干预、动态生成检测阈值的功率异常检测方法，为非线性波动能源系统的异常检测提供了新的技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为类似机场的BHS功率异常检测提供了可行技术方案和方法支持，为管理部门实现精准能耗控制提供了科学参考。

title: Material Risk: Climate-Risk Disclosure and the Capital Markets

detail.title: Material Risk: Climate-Risk Disclosure and the Capital Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this Article. This Article was self-funded and prepared in the author's individual capacity.
declarations.funderStatement: This Article is self-funded. The views expressed herein are solely those of the author and do not reflect the views of the University of California, the California Air Resources Board, or any other institution or entity.

detail.abstract: Climate-related financial risk poses significant challenges for public companies and their investors. Yet whether issuers must disclose physical risks, transition risks, regulatory exposure, emissions-related liabilities, and stranded-asset risks is too often framed as climate policy or environmental regulation. This Article argues that it is neither. It is a question about information—and one the existing federal securities-disclosure framework is already equipped to answer. Environmental, energy, land-use, and climate-regulatory regimes generate information about climate-related exposure, including emissions, compliance costs, permitting constraints, adaptation obligations, transition costs, and asset vulnerability. Securities regulation, through the disclosure framework established by the Securities Act of 1933, the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and the SEC’s implementing regulations, determines when that information must be provided to investors. And the First Amendment permits compelled disclosure of factual commercial information. Together, these doctrines already authorize disclosure of climaterelated financial risk when that information would matter to a reasonable investor. The shortfall is not statutory power, but implementation and enforcement. Climate-risk disclosure is not environmental regulation masquerading as securities law. It is an application of the federal securities-disclosure regime’s core premise: investors need accurate, complete, and equally available data to price risk.

AI.tldr: 本文论证气候相关金融风险披露本质上是证券信息披露问题，而非环境监管问题。现有联邦证券披露框架（1933年证券法、1934年证券交易法及SEC法规）已具备要求企业披露气候风险的法定权力，问题不在于立法授权不足，而在于执行和执法不力。
AI.research_question: 气候相关金融风险披露究竟是环境监管还是证券信息披露问题？现有联邦证券法框架是否有权要求发行人披露气候风险？
AI.motivation: 气候风险对上市公司及其投资者构成重大挑战，但关于发行人是否必须披露物理风险、转型风险、监管风险、排放相关负债及搁浅资产风险的问题，常被错误地框定为气候政策或环境监管议题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦证券披露框架（1933年证券法、1934年证券交易法及SEC实施条例）；第一修正案对事实性商业信息强制披露的许可；合理投资者标准。
AI.method: 法律规范性分析与 doctrinal 研究，审视证券法、第一修正案及环境能源法规之间的交叉关系。
AI.findings: 环境、能源、土地利用和气候监管体制生成的气候相关信息（包括排放、合规成本、许可限制、适应义务、转型成本和资产脆弱性），在证券法框架下当其对合理投资者具有重要性时，已被授权要求披露。短板不在于法定权力，而在于实施和执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了气候风险披露的法律性质——它既不是伪装成证券法的环境监管，也不是气候政策，而是联邦证券披露制度核心前提（投资者需要准确、完整、平等可得的数据来定价风险）的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SEC要求气候风险披露提供了法律正当性论证；指出问题核心在于执行而非立法；厘清了证券法与气候/环境法规之间的边界与协作关系。

title: Tariffs and Strategic Upstream Sourcing
affiliations: , National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School and National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School

detail.title: Tariffs and Strategic Upstream Sourcing
detail.abstract: We examine an upstream import shifting strategy where firms, in response to tariff increases, import upstream components and complete final assembly domestically, while keeping the rest of the value chain abroad. This approach mitigates tariff costs while preserving future flexibility. Using transaction-level shipment data and exploiting product-level tariff shocks from 2011 to 2019, we document that tariff hikes lead firms to expand imports toward more upstream inputs. The response is stronger among firms with limited cost pass-through, a shorter expected tariff horizon, lower supply-chain coordination costs, and greater tax sophistication. Upstream import shifting raises hiring for assembly work but leaves overall employment and firm scope unchanged. Our findings identify an underexplored adjustment margin bridging short-term cost management and long-term restructuring, and they reveal uneven impacts of tariff policies across firms with varying logistical and legal sophistication.

AI.tldr: 企业通过将进口转向更上游的中间品（即进口上游组件并在国内完成最终组装，其余价值链留在海外）来应对关税上升，这种策略在降低关税成本的同时保持了未来灵活性。
AI.research_question: 企业如何通过"上游进口转移"策略应对关税上升？这一策略的驱动因素和经济后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注企业通过搬迁整个供应链或终端产品涨价来应对关税，但忽略了"部分转移"（即只将价值链的上游环节转移至国内）这一中间调整路径。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税成本规避理论、供应链灵活性理论、成本转嫁理论。
AI.method: 使用2011-2019年交易层面的货物数据，利用产品层面的关税冲击进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）关税上升促使企业扩大对更上游中间品的进口；（2）成本转嫁能力有限、预期关税持续时间较短、供应链协调成本较低、税务筹划能力更强的企业，这种反应更明显；（3）上游进口转移增加了组装岗位的招聘，但总体就业和公司规模不变。

AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了关税政策对不同物流和法律成熟度企业的非对称影响，为政策制定者评估关税的分配效应提供了依据。

title: The BDC Method™: A Formation-First Standard for Delivery Capability in Major Infrastructure Programmes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The BDC Method™: A Formation-First Standard for Delivery Capability in Major Infrastructure Programmes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the originator and owner of the BDC Method™ described in this paper, and operates BDC (Building Delivery Capability), an independent practice that provides services based on the Method. The Method and associated assessment instrument are the author's intellectual property (trade mark application pending). The author therefore has a commercial interest in the subject of this paper. No other competing interests are declared.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: Major infrastructure programmes underperform with striking consistency: across a database of more than 16,000 projects, fewer than one in a hundred deliver on time, on budget and with the benefits promised (Flyvbjerg, 2014; Flyvbjerg & Gardner, 2023). This paper argues that the dominant explanation is not delivery competence but formation: the conditions for consistent delivery are rarely put in place deliberately across the portfolio, programme and project before, or alongside, the work. It introduces the BDC Method™, a single, evidence-based standard that names the capabilities a portfolio, programme and project must hold — organised as 52 themes in four groups (Core, Level, Domain, Formation) — and renders each one measurable. The Method distinguishes itself from maturity models by asking not how mature an organisation's processes are, but whether the required capabilities are in fact in place and operating, judged on evidence. It defines three modes of application — Formation, Assessment and Remediation — and is put to work through a weighted, multi-level assessment instrument that produces a single capability score and a Red/Amber/Green profile. The approach extends the established UK practice of sponsor/client capability assessment at project initiation (HM Treasury & IPA, 2014) from a one-off review into a continuously owned, in-house standard. This paper sets out the conceptual model and its application; the detailed assessment instrument is held as proprietary intellectual property and is described here in structure rather than in content.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大型基础设施项目表现不佳的根本原因在于"形成（Formation）"而非交付能力，并提出了BDC Method™——一个基于证据的标准化框架，涵盖52个主题、四大组别，通过加权多级评估工具衡量项目组合、项目集和项目所需的能力是否真正到位并发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 为什么大型基础设施项目持续表现不佳，以及如何通过标准化的能力评估方法改善项目形成阶段的绩效？
AI.motivation: 超过16000个项目的数据库显示，不到1%的项目能按时、按预算交付并实现预期收益，这表明传统以交付能力为主导的解释不足以解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目形成（Formation）理论、能力基础观（Capability-Based View）、证据导向的评估方法，区别于成熟度模型（Maturity Models）。
AI.method: 提出BDC Method™概念模型，包含52个主题、四大组别（Core, Level, Domain, Formation），采用加权多级评估工具，产生单一能力得分和红/黄/绿（RAG）画像；同时借鉴并扩展了英国HM Treasury & IPA的发起人/客户能力评估实践。
AI.findings: 项目绩效不佳的主导原因不是交付能力，而是形成（Formation）阶段的条件未能被有意设置；BDC Method™提供了一种将一次性评估转变为持续内部标准的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分"形成"与"交付能力"作为项目失败的解释机制；提出区别于成熟度模型的能力到位（capability-in-place）评估逻辑，即不问过程成熟度，而问所需能力是否基于证据实际存在并运行。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型基础设施项目提供了一套可操作的、基于证据的标准化能力评估框架（BDC Method™），支持形成（Formation）、评估（Assessment）和补救（Remediation）三种应用模式，可将英国政府的一次性审查实践转化为组织内部持续拥有的标准。

title: Inference-Subordinate Simulation: Decoupling Agent Decision Time from Playback Time in 3D Environments
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Inference-Subordinate Simulation: Decoupling Agent Decision Time from Playback Time in 3D Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study. The author is independently employed in a technical capacity, unrelated to this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All costs, including API and compute expenses, were personally funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Intelligent agent simulation has historically been constrained by a fundamental coupling: the simulation must run at the speed of the agent's decision-making process. When the decision-making agent is a large language model (LLM), this constraint becomes severeinference latency of several seconds per decision makes real-time simulation infeasible, forcing a tradeoff between agent intelligence and simulation throughput. We present inference-subordinate simulation, an architectural pattern that eliminates this constraint by inverting the relationship between simulation and inference. Rather than the simulation running continuously and the agent reacting in real time, the simulation engine advances only when the agent issues a decision. Each decision is logged with full state and timing metadata. Playback reads the decision log and reproduces identical behavior at any speed, without re-running inference. We implement this architecture using Godot 4 as the simulation engine, a Python HTTP server as the inference layer, and Claude (claude-opus-4-5) as the vision-language agent. The agent observes the 3D environment through a bird's eye camera, reasons about spatial relationships, and issues structured tool calls that advance world state. Across 26 empirical runs comprising 222 decisions, the agent achieved a 100% goal success rate with a mean inference time of 4.53 seconds per decision (σ = 1.12s) and a mean good move rate of 90.5%. Across 26 runs, the mean total inference time was 38.66 seconds per run. The same decision sequences replay in under one second at 10× speed-a demonstration that playback time is fully decoupled from inference time and adjustable as a free parameter. The representative run used to illustrate this comparison was selected to match the dataset mean, not to maximize the speedup figure. The architecture is model-agnostic at the inference layer: any vision-language model can be substituted without modifying the simulation engine or replay system. Navigation quality is model-dependent; we document the failure of a 7B local model and the successful substitution of a capable API model, treating this as an honest characterization of current model capabilities rather than an architectural limitation. We discuss applications in cinematic production, video game NPC pre-computation, reinforcement learning training data generation, and social science modeling where the real-time constraint is absent and the decoupled architecture offers substantial practical advantages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"推理从属于模拟"的架构模式，通过将大语言模型决策与仿真引擎解耦，消除了实时仿真中LLM推理延迟带来的瓶颈。使用Godot 4和Claude实现，在26次实验（222个决策）中达到100%目标成功率，回放速度可提升10倍以上。
AI.research_question: 如何消除大语言模型作为决策主体时，推理延迟对实时仿真的约束？
AI.motivation: 传统智能体仿真中，仿真必须与智能体决策速度耦合。当使用LLM作为决策智能体时，每次推理需数秒延迟，使得实时仿真变得不可行，迫使开发者在智能体智能性与仿真吞吐量之间做出权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 推理从属于模拟（inference-subordinate simulation）：将传统"仿真连续运行、智能体实时响应"的关系倒置，仿真引擎仅在智能体做出决策时向前推进，决策日志记录完整状态与时间元数据，回放时无需重新执行推理。
AI.method: 以Godot 4为仿真引擎、Python HTTP服务器为推理层、Claude为视觉-语言智能体。智能体通过鸟瞰摄像头观察3D环境，推理空间关系并发出结构化工具调用，推进世界状态。决策被记录为日志，支持任意速度回放。
AI.findings: 26次实验共222个决策中，智能体目标成功率达100%，平均推理时间4.53秒/决策（σ=1.12s），平均好移动率90.5%，平均总推理时间38.66秒/次。相同决策序列在10倍速下回放时间不足1秒。架构在推理层与模型无关，7B本地模型失败但可替换为API模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"推理从属于模拟"这一新的仿真架构模式，从根本上解耦了推理时间与仿真回放时间，使回放速度成为可自由调节的参数，突破了传统仿真中决策速度与仿真速度的绑定关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 该架构可应用于影视制作、游戏NPC预计算、强化学习训练数据生成和社会科学建模等场景，在这些场景中实时约束不存在，解耦架构能带来实质性优势。同时支持任意视觉-语言模型替换，具有良好的可扩展性。

title: Founder Factories: The Origins of High-Growth Startups
affiliations: HEC Paris - Finance Department,  and HEC

detail.title: Founder Factories: The Origins of High-Growth Startups
detail.abstract: This paper asks whether some employers influence the kinds of startups their employees later build. Using global career-history data matched to startup outcomes, we identify founders' previous employers and build an alumni startup-scale score for each employer. The score captures how often a firm's former employees go on to found startups that become unusually large, after accounting for employer size; it also predicts international reach and acquisition activity. We then study employees whose firms were acquired, which exposed them to new employers with different alumni startup-scale scores. Founders exposed to higher-score acquirers seem more ambitious in terms of scalability of their businesses at launch according to early business descriptions. We show this using archived startup websites from the founding period. These founders' startups later employ more people, operate in more countries, and more often make acquisitions. The patterns are stronger for employees who are integrated into the acquiring firm, and they are not explained by founders simply entering the acquirer's industry, hiring from the acquirer, or receiving financing from it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究前雇主如何影响员工后续创办的初创企业规模。通过全球职业历史数据发现，被高"校友初创规模评分"雇主收购的企业员工，其后来创办的初创企业更注重可扩展性、规模更大、国际化程度更高，且更频繁进行并购。
AI.research_question: 雇主是否会影响其员工后来创办的初创企业的规模和质量？
AI.motivation: 理解初创企业创始人行为差异的来源，特别是前雇主环境对创始人创业抱负和初创企业成长的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织印记理论、人力资本理论、创业学习理论
AI.method: 使用全球职业历史数据与初创企业成果数据匹配；构建"校友初创规模评分"衡量前雇主；利用企业收购作为外生冲击（准实验设计）；通过存档初创网站分析早期商业描述；进行异质性分析和排除替代解释。
AI.findings: 1) 接触高评分收购方的员工创办的初创企业更注重可扩展性；2) 这些初创企业雇佣更多员工、在更多国家运营、更常进行收购；3) 效应在融入收购方的员工中更强；4) 并非由行业进入、人才招聘或融资渠道等替代机制解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了雇主对员工创业行为的印记效应，拓展了组织印记理论至创业领域；提供了前雇主影响创始人创业抱负的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对创业政策制定者、风险投资者和企业管理者具有启示意义，说明工作环境如何塑造创业人才的质量和创业企业的成长潜力。

title: Lift-Sample-Repair for BOM-Structured Production Planning with Agent-Assisted Policy Search
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Jiaotong University, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Information Management and Engineering and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Information Management and Engineering

detail.title: Lift-Sample-Repair for BOM-Structured Production Planning with Agent-Assisted Policy Search
detail.abstract: We study integrated production planning and aggregate scheduling for large-scale make-to-order manufacturing. Each order carries bill-of-materials (BOM) requirements and routing operations, while orders compete for shared work-center capacity over time. Time-indexed mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulations model this setting directly, but become difficult to solve at industrial scale. We propose Lift-Sample-Repair (LSR), an LP-guided rounding method that converts a fractional LP solution into a reduced set of precedence-feasible whole-order timing patterns, samples one pattern per order, and repairs sharedcapacity violations. We prove that this lift recovers a whole-order support whose size is linear in each order's operation-period grid and that the expected loss relative to the LP benchmark is sublinear under capacity granularity, with an O(√ N) bound when individual orders are small relative to capacity. These results provide theoretical support for LSR's computational efficiency and solution quality. Empirically, base LSR reaches 94%-98% of the LP benchmark at the three largest tested scales, where the original time-indexed MILP certifies only 22 of 108 attempts within a two-hour budget. A loss decomposition shows that much of the residual gap remains after pattern construction, in pattern selection and repair. This motivates Agent-LSR, which automates policy search within the modular LSR interface. An LLM coding agent searches implementable rules for sampling, repair, refill, and multi-pass selection, while the recovered pattern set, model, LP relaxation, and feasibility guard remain fixed. On challenging structured instances, it reduces the average LP-relative gap from about 24% to about 6%. In an industrial PCB case study, LSR improves LP-relative performance relative to representative planning baselines, attaining mean LP-relative gaps below 1% on a fine-grained mass-production plant and 11.4% on a coarser custom plant under Agent-LSR. Beyond constructing feasible planning schedules, the same interface turns LP capacity shadow prices into managerial diagnostics for order triage, bottleneck-capacity planning, and decentralized work-center coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lift-Sample-Repair（LSR）方法，解决大规模按单制造（MTO）环境下的集成生产计划与聚合调度问题。LSR通过LP引导的舍入方法，将松弛解转化为可行调度方案，并进一步引入Agent-LSR（LLM编码代理自动搜索策略）来缩小与LP基准的差距。理论证明LSR的支撑集规模和期望损失上界，实验表明在大规模实例上达到94%-98%的LP基准水平，工业PCB案例中Agent-LSR可将平均LP相对差距降至6%以下。
AI.research_question: 如何高效求解大规模按单制造（MTO）系统中集成生产计划与聚合调度问题？
AI.motivation: 大规模按单制造场景下，时间索引的混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型虽然能直接建模，但在工业规模下难以求解（仅22/108能在两小时内获得最优解）。需要一种兼具计算效率和理论保证的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: LP松弛引导的舍入方法、支撑集线性增长理论、期望损失亚线性上界（O(√N)）、模式构建-采样-修复的三阶段框架。
AI.method: 提出LSR方法：1）Lift（提升）：将LP分数解转化为订货的时间模式集；2）Sample（采样）：从每个订货的模式集中随机采样一个模式；3）Repair（修复）：修复共享产能的违规问题。进一步引入Agent-LSR，利用LLM编码代理自动化搜索采样、修复、填充和多轮选择的策略规则。
AI.findings: 1）理论证明LSR的支撑集与订货-时段网格呈线性关系，期望损失在产能粒度下为O(√N)；2）基础LSR在大规模测试中达到LP基准的94%-98%；3）Agent-LSR将挑战性实例的LP相对差距从约24%降至约6%；4）工业PCB案例中，细粒度量产工厂平均LP相对差距低于1%，粗粒度定制工厂为11.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）证明了LSR方法中提升操作恢复的整数支撑集与操作-时段网格呈线性大小关系；2）证明了在产能细粒度条件下期望损失相对于LP基准具有亚线性上界（O(√N)），为LP引导舍入法提供了理论保障。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了一种高效可行的大规模生产调度求解方法（LSR/Agent-LSR），可在两小时内为数十个原MILP无法求解的实例提供高质量解；2）将同一框架扩展为管理诊断工具，利用LP容量影子价格支持订单分类、瓶颈产能规划和去中心化工位协调；3）LLM编码代理自动化策略搜索的范式为运筹优化中的算法设计提供了新思路。

title: Occupational Psychological Profiles of Heavy-Haul Railway Drivers: A Latent Profile Analysis Based on Job Stressors, Job Satisfaction, Resilience, and Burnout
affiliations: City University of Macau, City University of Macau, City University of Macau, affiliation not provided to SSRN and City University of Macau

detail.title: Occupational Psychological Profiles of Heavy-Haul Railway Drivers: A Latent Profile Analysis Based on Job Stressors, Job Satisfaction, Resilience, and Burnout
detail.abstract: Heavy-haul railway driving is a safety-critical occupation marked by sustained workload, organizational constraints, and very limited tolerance for error. Although psychological functioning in such groups is often examined using isolated variables, this approach may miss the patterned ways in which occupational demands, resources, and strain are organized within individuals. Guided by the Job Demands–Resources (JD-R) framework, the present study adopted a person-centered approach to identify occupational psychological profiles among heavy-haul railway drivers in China. A total of 1,117 drivers completed measures of job stressors, job satisfaction, resilience, and occupational burnout. Anxiety, psychological capital, and family functioning were included as external validating variables. Latent profile analysis was used to compare one- to five-class solutions. Although information criteria continued to improve as additional classes were extracted, the three-class solution was retained because it combined acceptable fit, high entropy, meaningful interpretation, and the absence of extremely small classes. The three profiles were labeled ”high stress–high burnout”, ”high resource–well-adapted”, and ”intermediate stable”. These profiles differed significantly in anxiety, psychological capital, and family functioning, whereas age did not distinguish them. Drivers in the high stress–high burnout profile reported the highest work stressors, burnout, and anxiety, together with the lowest job satisfaction, resilience, psychological capital, and family support. By contrast, the high resource–well-adapted profile showed the most favorable pattern across all validating indicators. The findings suggest that the occupational mental health of heavy-haul railway drivers is better understood as a configuration of demands, resources, and strain than as the effect of any single factor. A profile-based perspective may therefore provide a more useful basis for screening and targeted intervention in safety-critical railway settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用以人为中心的方法（潜在剖面分析），基于JD-R框架识别了中国重载铁路司机的三种职业心理剖面：高压力-高倦怠型、高资源-良好适应型和中间稳定型。三种剖面在焦虑、心理资本和家庭功能上存在显著差异，证明了职业心理健康应被理解为需求、资源和压力的整体配置而非单一因素的作用。
AI.research_question: 重载铁路司机的职业心理特征是否可以在个体层面被归纳为不同的剖面类型？这些剖面类型在外部验证变量（焦虑、心理资本、家庭功能）上是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 重载铁路驾驶是高安全敏感性职业，长期承受高工作负荷、组织约束和极低的容错率。以往研究多采用孤立变量分析心理功能，忽视了职业需求、资源和压力在个体内部的模式化组织方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: Job Demands–Resources (JD-R) 框架；以人为中心（person-centered）的研究视角；潜在剖面分析（LPA）
AI.method: 对1,117名中国重载铁路司机进行问卷调查，测量工作压力源、工作满意度、心理韧性、职业倦怠，并以焦虑、心理资本和家庭功能作为外部验证变量。采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）比较一至五类模型的拟合度，最终保留三分类解决方案。
AI.findings: 三分类模型被保留，分别命名为"高压力-高倦怠型"、"高资源-良好适应型"和"中间稳定型"。三种剖面在焦虑、心理资本和家庭功能上差异显著，但年龄无差异。高压力-高倦怠型报告最高的工作压力、倦怠和焦虑，以及最低的工作满意度、韧性、心理资本和家庭支持；高资源-良好适应型在所有验证指标上表现最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 将JD-R框架从变量中心视角拓展到以人为中心的视角，证明职业心理健康是需求、资源和压力的整体配置结果，而非单一因素的线性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安全关键性铁路岗位的心理筛查和针对性干预提供了基于剖面分类的实践依据，有助于识别高风险群体并制定差异化支持策略。

title: Determinants of Continuance Intention to Use Digital Wallets Among Thai Consumers: An Integration of UTAUT and the Expectation Confirmation Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Determinants of Continuance Intention to Use Digital Wallets Among Thai Consumers: An Integration of UTAUT and the Expectation Confirmation Model
detail.abstract: This study aims to advance the understanding of post-adoption behavior in digital payment services by examining the factors influencing Thai consumers' continuance intention to use e-wallets. Drawing on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) and the Expectation Confirmation Model (ECM), the study investigates how performance expectancy, effort expectancy, promotion, perceived trust, and user satisfaction jointly explain users' intentions to continue using e-wallet services. Data were collected from 411 Thai consumers with prior experience using e-wallets, providing empirical evidence from a rapidly expanding digital payment market. While previous studies have primarily focused on the direct determinants of continuance intention, this study extends the literature by examining the mechanisms through which these factors influence users' post-adoption evaluations. In particular, it explores two additional mediation pathways that have received limited attention in prior research. Specifically, the study investigates whether performance expectancy mediates the relationship between promotion and user satisfaction, and whether effort expectancy mediates the relationship between perceived trust and user satisfaction. By examining these indirect relationships, the study provides a more comprehensive understanding of how promotional activities and trust contribute to user satisfaction and, ultimately, continuance intention. These findings also strengthen the integration of UTAUT and ECM in explaining continued technology usage.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合UTAUT和ECM模型，通过对411名泰国消费者的调查，探讨了绩效期望、努力期望、促销、感知信任和用户满意度如何共同影响用户持续使用电子钱包的意愿，并发现了促销→绩效期望→满意度、信任→努力期望→满意度两条新的中介路径。
AI.research_question: 什么因素影响泰国消费者持续使用电子钱包的意愿？绩效期望和努力期望在促销与满意度、信任与满意度之间是否起到中介作用？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注持续使用意愿的直接决定因素，忽略了其中的中介机制。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究促销与信任如何通过绩效期望和努力期望间接影响用户满意度，从而更全面地理解数字支付服务的后采纳行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合技术接受与使用统一理论（UTAUT）和期望确认模型（ECM）。
AI.method: 对411名有电子钱包使用经验的泰国消费者进行问卷调查，采用定量分析方法检验假设模型。
AI.findings: 1）绩效期望、努力期望、促销、感知信任和用户满意度共同影响持续使用意愿；2）绩效期望在促销与用户满意度之间起中介作用；3）努力期望在感知信任与用户满意度之间起中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）发现两条新的中介路径，深化了对UTAUT和ECM整合模型的理解；2）揭示了促销和信任影响持续使用意愿的间接机制，扩展了后采纳行为研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字支付服务提供商提供了策略启示：通过促销活动提升用户对绩效的预期，以及通过建立信任降低用户的使用努力感知，从而增强用户满意度和持续使用意愿。

title: Physics-Informed Surrogate Modeling and Multi-Objective Stochastic Optimization for Data Center Cooling and Explainable Anomaly Detection
affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Clemson University and Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Physics-Informed Surrogate Modeling and Multi-Objective Stochastic Optimization for Data Center Cooling and Explainable Anomaly Detection
detail.abstract: High-ambient, humid-climate data centers often rely on static cooling schedules and siloed energy strategies, causing avoidable in efficiency and unnecessary grid stress, a gap that is especially acute in emerging markets where real operational cooling data remain scarce. This study develops and validates an integrated, physics-informed, multi-objective, and explainable decision-support frame work for data-center cooling, built from three months (8,736 fifteen-minute records) of Data Center Infrastructure Management telemetry from a Tier-III colocation facility in Bangladesh, cross-checked against ERA5 reanalysis weather data. Baseline Power Usage Effectiveness averages 1.806, with humidity and ambient temperature driving significant cooling degradation. Monotonicity constrained surrogate models predict cooling power, Power Usage Effectiveness, coefficient-of-performance proxy, and grid import with held-out error of 3.9 to 18.1 per cent, the higher figure diagnosing an unmetered on-site generator rather than a modeling failure. An explainable long short-term memory autoencoder achieves an area under the curve of 0.77, against 0.69 for an isolation forest baseline. A non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm identifies a Pareto-optimal policy that cuts on-peak cooling power by 23.3 per cent, exceeding its target, while reducing Power Usage Effectiveness by a bounded 0.83 per cent, both confirmed through historical replay with block-bootstrap confidence intervals. Where a result falls short of its target, the shortfall is explained rather than concealed, an evidentiary contribution from an under-represented climate and market.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用孟加拉国一个Tier-III数据中心三个月的运行数据，开发并验证了一个集成物理信息、多目标、可解释的冷却决策框架。通过单调性约束代理模型、可解释LSTM自编码器和非支配排序遗传算法，实现了将高峰冷却电力降低23.3%，同时将PUE仅增加0.83%。
AI.research_question: 如何为高温高湿气候条件下的数据中心开发一个集成、可解释、多目标的冷却优化决策框架？
AI.motivation: 高温高湿气候的数据中心常采用静态冷却策略和孤立的能源策略，导致效率低下和不必要的电网压力。尤其在新兴市场，实际运行冷却数据稀缺，缺乏针对性的优化方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息机器学习、单调性约束代理模型、LSTM自编码器异常检测、非支配排序遗传算法(NSGA-II)、帕累托最优理论
AI.method: 收集孟加拉国Tier-III数据中心三个月（8,736个15分钟记录）的DCIM遥测数据，与ERA5再分析天气数据交叉验证。构建单调性约束代理模型预测冷却功率、PUE、COP代理和电网进口。采用可解释LSTM自编码器进行异常检测，通过NSGA-II识别帕累托最优策略，并使用历史回放和块自助置信区间验证。
AI.findings: 1) 基准PUE平均为1.806，湿度和环境温度是冷却性能退化的主要驱动因素。2) 代理模型预测误差在3.9%至18.1%之间，较高误差源于未计量的现场发电机而非模型失败。3) LSTM自编码器AUC为0.77，优于隔离森林的0.69。4) 帕累托最优策略将高峰冷却电力降低23.3%（超出目标），同时PUE仅增加0.83%（在约束范围内）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将物理信息、单调性约束、可解释AI和多目标优化集成的冷却决策框架；为高温高湿气候这一代表性不足的市场提供了实证贡献；展示了用可解释方法暴露数据质量问题的能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场高温高湿气候的数据中心提供了经过验证的冷却优化策略，可降低23.3%的高峰冷却电力消耗，且对PUE影响极小；框架具有可解释性，当结果未达标时能揭示原因而非掩盖问题。

title: Unlocking Green Technology Convergence: Differentiated AI Capabilities, Innovation Objectives, and Knowledge-Source Diversity
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: Unlocking Green Technology Convergence: Differentiated AI Capabilities, Innovation Objectives, and Knowledge-Source Diversity
detail.abstract: In accelerating global intelligent development, companies are increasingly inclined to combine intelligent technologies with environmentally oriented innovation. However, existing research offers limited insights into how artificial intelligence influences green technology convergence. Drawing on the resource-based view, this study investigates how logic-based AI and learning-based AI affect green technology convergence and how firms’ innovation objectives and knowledge sources moderate these relationships. Using a panel of listed manufacturing firms from 2015 to 2022, we find that both dimensions of artificial intelligence significantly promote the integration of green technologies, while learning-based AI has a more pronounced effect. Moreover, these positive effects become stronger when firms pursue broader green innovation objectives, and when they rely on more diverse knowledge sources. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that the associations are stronger in non-state-owned firms and high-tech firms. This study enriches boundary-condition research on how differentiated AI capabilities shape green technology convergence and highlights the contingent roles of innovation objectives and knowledge-source diversity in translating AI capabilities into green technological recombination. Practically, it offers actionable insights for firms seeking to deploy differentiated AI capabilities to support sustainable innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于资源基础观，探讨逻辑型AI与学习型AI对绿色技术融合的影响，发现两者均能显著促进绿色技术融合，且学习型AI效果更显著；这一正向关系在更广泛的绿色创新目标和更多元的知识来源条件下更强，在非国有和高技术企业中尤为突出。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（逻辑型AI与学习型AI）如何影响企业绿色技术融合？企业的创新目标与知识来源如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对人工智能如何影响绿色技术融合的机制认识有限，缺乏从AI能力差异化视角出发的深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View）
AI.method: 使用2015–2022年制造业上市公司面板数据，采用计量回归方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）逻辑型AI和学习型AI均显著促进绿色技术融合；（2）学习型AI的促进作用更强；（3）更广泛的绿色创新目标和更多元的知识来源增强了这一正向效应；（4）在非国有企业和高技术企业中效应更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了差异化AI能力如何塑造绿色技术融合的边界条件研究，揭示了创新目标与知识来源多样性在将AI能力转化为绿色技术重组中的权变作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何部署差异化AI能力以支持可持续创新提供了可操作的见解。

title: Naphtha Feedstock Lock-in in Korean Manufacturing Implications for Dual-Track Industrial Decarbonization Pathways, 2016-2022
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Naphtha Feedstock Lock-in in Korean Manufacturing Implications for Dual-Track Industrial Decarbonization Pathways, 2016-2022
detail.abstract: Decarbonizing petrochemicals requires separating fossil energy used for process services from fossil carbon embedded in products. This study harmonizes the 2017, 2020 and 2023 vintages of Korea's Energy Consumption Survey, representing 2016, 2019 and 2022, to test whether a falling naphtha share indicates structural transition. Four auditable measures are applied: a Naphtha Dependency Index, industrial concentration, allocation persistence based on total-variation distance, and an exact end-use decomposition. Manufacturing energy increased from 125.70 to 136.44 million tonnes of oil equivalent (Mtoe), whereas naphtha rose only from 52.68 to 53.47 Mtoe. Its share consequently fell from 41.9% to 39.2%, but more than 99.95% remained feedstock in every year. Over 99.99% of naphtha was allocated to refined petroleum, basic chemicals, and synthetic rubber and plastics, and the six-year allocation-persistence score was 0.909. Internal allocation nevertheless shifted: refined-petroleum naphtha fell by 2.36 Mtoe while synthetic rubber and plastics rose by 4.96 Mtoe. Electricity's share of process energy remained near 48%, showing no parallel aggregate electrification. These results identify relative decline without absolute exit and demonstrate that process-energy decarbonization cannot substitute for carbon-feedstock defossilization. A dual-track strategy is required: efficiency, electrification and low-carbon heat for process services; and material efficiency, circular carbon, sustainable biogenic carbon and electricity-based molecules for product carbon. The dataset provides an empirical baseline for cluster-level infrastructure planning and future energy-system models, while avoiding causal or cost claims that the published tables cannot identify.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析韩国2016-2022年的能源消费数据，发现石脑油在制造业能源中的占比虽从41.9%下降至39.2%，但绝对消费量几乎未变（52.68→53.47 Mtoe），且超过99.95%仍用作原料而非燃料。这表明石脑油出现了相对下降但未实现绝对退出，电力在过程能源中的份额保持48%左右，未出现整体电气化趋势。研究提出需要双轨战略：过程服务侧依靠效率提升、电气化和低碳热源；产品碳侧依靠材料效率、循环碳、可持续生物碳和电基分子。
AI.research_question: 韩国石化产业是否正在经历结构性转型？石脑油份额的下降是否反映了化石燃料的实质性退出？
AI.motivation: 石化行业脱碳需要区分过程服务用化石能源和产品中嵌入的化石碳。研究者希望检验石脑油份额下降是否标志着产业结构性转型，为脱碳战略提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源转型理论、工业结构变迁理论、化石燃料脱碳双轨战略（过程服务脱碳 vs. 产品碳脱化石化）
AI.method: 整合韩国2017、2020和2023年能源消费调查数据（分别代表2016、2019和2022年），采用四种可审计指标：石脑油依赖指数（NDI）、产业集中度、基于全变差距离（total-variation distance）的分配持续性、精确终端用途分解。
AI.findings: 1) 石脑油份额从41.9%降至39.2%，但绝对消费量几乎未变；2) 超过99.95%的石脑油始终用作原料；3) 超99.99%石脑油分配给精炼石油、基础化工、合成橡胶和塑料；4) 六年分配持续性得分为0.909；5) 内部结构变化：精炼石油石脑油减少2.36 Mtoe，合成橡胶和塑料增加4.96 Mtoe；6) 电力在过程能源中的份额保持在48%左右，无整体电气化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可审计的"相对下降但未绝对退出"概念，区分了份额下降与实质性脱碳的差异；证明了过程能源脱碳无法替代产品碳脱化石化，需要双轨战略框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国石化行业脱碳提供了实证基线，支持集群层面的基础设施规划和未来能源系统模型，明确了双轨战略方向：过程服务侧（效率、电气化、低碳热）和产品碳侧（材料效率、循环碳、生物碳、电基分子）。

title: Explaining Fraudulent Return Behavior in E-commerce: Evidence from an emerging country
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Explaining Fraudulent Return Behavior in E-commerce: Evidence from an emerging country
detail.abstract: Amid the rapid expansion of e-commerce in Vietnam, reaching USD 20.5 billion in 2023, fraudulent return behavior has emerged as a growing challenge for businesses. However, there remains a lack of in-depth research on the psychological drivers of such behavior in emerging markets. This study is the first in Vietnam to integrate the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) with personality traits—specifically narcissism and sensation seeking—to predict students’ intentions to engage in fraudulent return behavior. Using survey data from 544 economics students in Hanoi and structural equation modeling, the model explains 41.2% of the variance in behavioral intention, with perceived behavioral control identified as the strongest predictor. Notably, the study uncovers an unexpected negative relationship between narcissism and fraudulent return intention, contradicting prior international findings and suggesting that reputational concerns may serve as a protective factor in the Vietnamese cultural context. Multi-group analysis further reveals significant gender differences, with female respondents being more influenced by social factors. The study contributes to the literature on unethical consumer behavior by extending the TPB framework with personality dimensions and highlighting the moderating role of cultural context. It also offers practical implications for e-commerce platforms in designing targeted anti-fraud strategies based on demographic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次在越南整合计划行为理论与人格特质（自恋和感觉寻求）预测学生欺诈退货行为，通过对544名经济学学生的调查发现，感知行为控制是最强预测因子，自恋与欺诈意图呈负相关（出乎意料），且存在显著的性别差异。
AI.research_question: 在越南电商快速扩张的背景下，哪些心理因素（包括人格特质和计划行为理论变量）驱动学生的欺诈退货意图？
AI.motivation: 越南电商市场2023年达到205亿美元，欺诈退货行为成为企业的严峻挑战，但新兴市场中此类行为的心理驱动因素缺乏深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（TPB）；人格特质理论（自恋与感觉寻求）
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集544名河内经济学学生数据，采用结构方程模型（SEM）进行数据分析，并进行多组分析检验性别差异。
AI.findings: 模型解释了41.2%的行为意图变异；感知行为控制是最强预测因子；自恋与欺诈退货意图呈负相关（出乎意料，与以往国际研究相悖）；存在显著性别差异，女性更受社会因素影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 在TPB框架中扩展人格维度，揭示了文化背景的调节作用，尤其是在越南文化背景下自恋与欺诈意图的负向关系表明声誉担忧可能成为保护因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台基于人口统计细分设计有针对性的反欺诈策略提供实践启示。

title: Climate‑Conditioned Hydrological Stress and Electricity Price Volatility in Aotearoa New Zealand: A Unified Scenario‑Based Analytical Framework
affiliations: Massey University - Massey University Auckland, Massey University - Massey University Auckland and Massey University - Massey University Auckland

detail.title: Climate‑Conditioned Hydrological Stress and Electricity Price Volatility in Aotearoa New Zealand: A Unified Scenario‑Based Analytical Framework
detail.abstract: Electricity price volatility in Aotearoa New Zealand is strongly shaped by hydrological scarcity within its hydro‑dependent generation system. This study develops a unified, scenario‑based analytical framework that links climate‑conditioned hydrological stress to wholesale price dynamics. Large‑scale climate modes (ENSO, SOI, PDO) influence market outcomes primarily through their effects on inflows and storage, amplifying dry‑year risk. Using an expanding‑window XGBoost model (2018–2024), feature‑importance and bootstrap‑stability analyses show that hydrological variables dominate price formation, while climate signals exert secondary but persistent influence. Scenario‑conditioned simulations reveal pronounced asymmetry in dry‑year price distributions, with tail‑risk metrics (VaR₉₀, ETL₉₀) rising sharply under climate‑conditioned dry states. The framework provides a quantitative basis for early‑warning systems, procurement planning, and resilience assessment in hydro‑dependent electricity markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个将气候条件水文压力与电力批发价格动态联系起来的情景分析框架，发现新西兰水电依赖型电力市场的电价波动主要由水文变量驱动，气候信号（ENSO、SOI、PDO）通过影响入库水量和水库储量产生间接但持续的影响，干旱年份价格尾部风险显著上升。
AI.research_question: 在新西兰水电依赖型电力系统中，气候条件导致的水文稀缺如何影响电力批发价格的波动？
AI.motivation: 新西兰电力系统高度依赖水电，水文稀缺是电价波动的关键因素，但目前缺乏一个将气候条件与水文压力系统性联系到电价动态的统一分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候-水文-电价联动框架：大尺度气候模式（ENSO、SOI、PDO）→水文流入与水库储量变化→水电供给能力→批发市场价格形成与尾部风险。
AI.method: 采用扩展窗口XGBoost模型（2018–2024年数据），结合特征重要性分析和Bootstrap稳定性检验，并进行情景条件模拟。
AI.findings: （1）水文变量主导电价形成；（2）气候信号对电价有次级但持续的影响；（3）干旱年份电价分布呈现显著不对称性；（4）尾部风险指标（VaR₉₀、ETL₉₀）在气候条件干旱状态下急剧上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的情景分析框架，量化了气候-水文-电价之间的传导机制，揭示了干旱年份电价尾部风险的非对称放大效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水电依赖型电力市场提供了早期预警系统、采购规划和韧性评估的定量工具基础。

title: Sci-tech finance and corporate innovation strategies in China: Evidence from the Enterprise Innovation Points System
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Saitama University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sci-tech finance and corporate innovation strategies in China: Evidence from the Enterprise Innovation Points System
detail.abstract: Sci-tech finance is an important policy instrument for improving the allocation of financial resources and strengthening firms’ innovation capabilities. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2015 to 2024, this study treats the Enterprise Innovation Points System as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences model to examine how sci-tech finance affects corporate innovation strategies. The results show that sci-tech finance promotes corporate innovation, with a stronger effect on breakthrough innovation than on incremental innovation. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that firms in technology-intensive industries and non-state-owned enterprises are more inclined toward breakthrough innovation, whereas state-owned enterprises and firms in non-technology-intensive industries tend to engage in incremental innovation. Mechanism tests show that sci-tech finance stimulates corporate innovation by easing financing constraints, improving financing efficiency, and reducing financing costs. Additional analysis further reveals that sci-tech finance generates spatial spillovers in breakthrough innovation and produces complementary effects with sci-tech sub-branches. These findings suggest that policymakers should deepen the integration of technology and finance and strengthen the enabling mechanisms through which sci-tech finance supports corporate innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2015-2024年中国上市公司数据，以企业创新积分制为准自然实验，采用双重差分模型研究科技金融对企业创新战略的影响。结果表明科技金融促进企业创新，对突破式创新的促进效果大于增量式创新；异质性分析显示技术密集型企业与非国有企业更倾向突破式创新，而国有企业与非技术密集型企业更倾向增量式创新；机制检验表明科技金融通过缓解融资约束、提升融资效率、降低融资成本来刺激企业创新；进一步分析发现科技金融在突破式创新上存在空间溢出效应，并与科技专营机构产生互补效应。
AI.research_question: 科技金融如何影响企业创新战略？具体而言，科技金融对企业突破式创新与增量式创新的差异化影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 科技金融是优化金融资源配置、增强企业创新能力的重要政策工具，但其对企业创新战略（尤其是突破式创新与增量式创新的区分）的影响尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融资约束理论、创新战略分类理论（突破式创新 vs. 增量式创新）、准自然实验与双重差分模型
AI.method: 以企业创新积分制为准自然实验，采用双重差分模型（DID），使用2015-2024年中国上市公司面板数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）科技金融显著促进企业创新，对突破式创新的促进效果强于增量式创新；（2）技术密集型企业与非国有企业更倾向突破式创新，国有企业与非技术密集型企业更倾向增量式创新；（3）科技金融通过缓解融资约束、提升融资效率、降低融资成本发挥作用；（4）科技金融在突破式创新上存在空间溢出效应，与科技专营机构存在互补效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了科技金融对企业创新战略的差异化影响研究，区分了突破式创新与增量式创新两种路径，丰富了科技金融与创新关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者深化科技与金融融合、完善科技金融支持企业创新的传导机制提供了实证依据和政策参考。

title: Exceeding convergence criteria within EMCCA and IMF standards: how far can regional discipline be 'maintained'?
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Exceeding convergence criteria within EMCCA and IMF standards: how far can regional discipline be 'maintained'?
detail.abstract: This research assesses the sustainability of the EMCCA fiscal rules regime in the face of exogenous shocks. Using a panel of six countries over the period 2000 –2025, linear, dynamic (GMM, ECM), and nonlinear (PTR, DPTR) models are employed to analyze the determinants of convergence criterion violations. The results show that oil dependence amplifies the effect of external shocks (H1), while economic diversification provides protection against them (H2). The DPTR model identifies a critical threshold of -15.2% for the variation in terms of trade the focal point of the research revealing that below this threshold, fiscal discipline is sustainable (with a half-life of 1.05 years); above it, sensitivity to shocks more than doubles and fiscal persistence increases by 38%. These findings argue for the introduction of conditional flexibility clauses into the Convergence Pact, as well as for a reform of multilateral surveillance and IMF programs in the region.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了EMCCA财政规则体系在面对外生冲击时的可持续性，利用六国面板数据（2000-2025年），采用线性、动态（GMM、ECM）和非线性（PTR、DPTR）模型分析趋同标准违规的决定因素。研究发现石油依赖放大外部冲击效应（H1），经济多元化提供保护（H2）。DPTR模型识别出-15.2%的贸易条件变动临界阈值：低于该阈值财政纪律可持续（半衰期1.05年），高于该阈值冲击敏感性翻倍、财政持续性增加38%。研究建议在《趋同公约》中引入有条件灵活条款，并改革该地区的多边监督和IMF项目。
AI.research_question: EMCCA财政规则体系在面对外生冲击时是否可持续？趋同标准违规的关键决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: EMCCA（中非经济与货币共同体）国家面临频繁的外部冲击（如大宗商品价格波动），其财政规则的有效性受到质疑。现有研究缺乏对冲击阈值效应的深入分析，本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政规则可持续性理论、外生冲击传导机制、门槛效应理论（非线性调整）、财政持续性（半衰期）理论
AI.method: 面板数据分析，使用六国2000-2025年数据；线性模型、动态模型（GMM、ECM）以及非线性模型（PTR面板阈值回归、DPTR动态面板阈值回归）
AI.findings: 1. 石油依赖放大外部冲击对财政纪律的负面影响（H1成立）；2. 经济多元化缓冲外部冲击（H2成立）；3. 贸易条件变动存在-15.2%的临界阈值，低于该阈值财政纪律可持续（半衰期1.05年），高于该阈值冲击敏感性和财政持续性显著恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非线性阈值模型（DPTR）引入财政规则可持续性研究，识别出外生冲击对财政纪律的非对称影响临界点，拓展了财政规则理论中对冲击非线性传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在《趋同公约》中引入有条件灵活条款，允许在极端冲击下临时偏离财政目标；改革多边监督机制和IMF在该地区的项目设计，增强财政规则对经济结构的适应性。

title: Renewable Energy and the Cost of Corporate Credit
affiliations: Columbia University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Renewable Energy and the Cost of Corporate Credit
detail.abstract: We study how renewable energy investment transmits to the cost of corporate credit. Using the staggered installation of solar and wind plants across counties in Chile from 2012 to 2023 and confidential bank loan-level data for the universe of firms, we find that borrowing costs for nearby non-energy firms decline by 27 basis points. Contract structure  explains the incidence of this gain: the effect is four times larger for firms that contract directly with energy producers than for firms purchasing at regulated tariffs. Within this group, we provide evidence consistent with both the repricing of existing contracts and new entry into the market, with repricing the stronger channel. The effect is largest for firms with older contracts, reinforcing the repricing interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用智利2012-2023年太阳能和风能电站的 staggered 布局及企业级贷款数据，发现可再生能源投资使附近非能源企业借贷成本降低27个基点，这一效应主要通过直接购电合同的重新定价实现，且对老合同企业影响更大。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源投资如何影响企业信贷成本？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注可再生能源对能源行业本身的影响，但对其通过降低电力成本传导至企业融资成本的机制研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可再生能源投资降低电力成本→企业运营成本下降→信用风险改善→借贷成本降低；合同结构（直接购电 vs 受监管电价）调节这一传导效应。
AI.method: 利用智利2012-2023年太阳能和风能电站的 staggered 安装作为准自然实验，结合全样本企业级机密银行贷款数据进行双重差分估计。
AI.findings: ①附近非能源企业借贷成本下降27个基点；②直接与能源生产商签订合同的企业效应是受监管电价企业的4倍；③效应来自现有合同重新定价（主要渠道）和新企业进入市场；④老合同企业效应最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可再生能源投资通过电力成本渠道向企业融资成本传导的微观机制，并识别了合同结构作为关键调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估可再生能源投资的正外部性（降低企业融资成本）提供依据；为企业优化电力合同安排提供参考。

title: Macroeconomic and environmental analysis of a green ammonia industry in Brazil
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Macroeconomic and environmental analysis of a green ammonia industry in Brazil
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the macroeconomic and environmental implications of establishing a green ammonia (NH₃) industry in Brazil through an integrated life cycle assessment (LCA) and input–output (IO) framework. We examine replacing fossil-based NH₃ with electrolytic NH₃ produced using wind and photovoltaic (PV) electricity, assuming a reference production capacity of 480 kt NH₃ yr⁻¹ by 2030. The levelized cost of ammonia (LCOA) is estimated at USD 698 t⁻¹ NH₃ for the wind pathway and USD 1,106 t⁻¹ NH₃ for the PV pathway, representing cost increases of 34% and 58%, respectively, relative to fossil-based ammonia. Capital expenditures are the primary cost driver, accounting for approximately 89% of the LCOA in both renewable pathways. Environmentally, the carbon intensity of green NH₃ is estimated at 0.20 kg CO₂e kg⁻¹ NH₃ for the wind pathway, and 0.48 kg CO₂e kg⁻¹ NH₃ for the PV pathway, compared with 2.17 kg CO₂e kg⁻¹ NH₃ for conventional natural gas-based production. The IO analysis indicates that replacing either imported or domestically produced fossil NH₃ in Brazil results predominantly in negative net macroeconomic effects, as higher production costs and the financing of subsidies reduce government-induced demand across other sectors of the economy. Overall, the results suggest that although green NH₃ offers substantial potential for emissions reductions in Brazil, its large-scale deployment will depend critically on targeted public support mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合生命周期评估（LCA）和投入产出（IO）框架，评估了巴西建立绿色氨（NH₃）产业对宏观经济和环境的影响。研究发现，虽然绿色氨（尤其是风电路径）能大幅降低碳排放（从2.17降至0.20 kg CO₂e kg⁻¹ NH₃），但生产成本显著高于化石基氨（风电路径成本增加34%，光伏路径增加58%），且由于高成本及补贴融资对政府需求产生挤出效应，在巴西替代进口或国产化石氨将导致负面的净宏观经济效应。因此，绿色氨的大规模部署高度依赖于针对性的公共支持机制。
AI.research_question: 在巴西建立绿色氨产业对宏观经济和环境会产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 绿色氨被视为减少工业碳排放的关键路径之一，但现有研究缺乏对其宏观经济影响的系统评估。巴西拥有丰富的可再生能源资源，是潜在的绿色氨生产大国，因此有必要综合评估其环境效益与宏观经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期评估（LCA）理论与投入产出（IO）分析框架。
AI.method: 整合生命周期评估（LCA）与投入产出（IO）框架。假设2030年参考产能为480 kt NH₃/年，比较风电与光伏两种电解制氨路径与传统化石基氨生产的经济与环境表现。
AI.findings: 1）风电路径LCOA为698美元/吨NH₃（成本增加34%），光伏路径为1,106美元/吨NH₃（成本增加58%）；2）资本支出占LCOA约89%；3）风电路径碳强度为0.20 kg CO₂e/kg NH₃，光伏路径为0.48 kg CO₂e/kg NH₃，远低于化石基的2.17 kg CO₂e/kg NH₃；4）在巴西替代进口或国产化石氨将产生负面的净宏观经济效应，原因是高生产成本及补贴融资挤出了其他部门的政府需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LCA与IO分析整合，为评估绿色氨技术的环境影响与宏观经济效应提供了综合分析框架，揭示了环境效益与宏观经济成本之间的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西及其他潜在绿色氨生产国的政策制定者提供了决策依据，指出绿色氨大规模部署需要针对性的公共支持机制（如补贴或政策激励），以缓解负面宏观经济影响并实现减排目标。

title: Artificial Neural Network Prediction of Viscoelastic Properties of Polymeric Nanocomposites: A Critical Reassessment of Data Preprocessing and Generalization Under Interpolation and Extrapolation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Artificial Neural Network Prediction of Viscoelastic Properties of Polymeric Nanocomposites: A Critical Reassessment of Data Preprocessing and Generalization Under Interpolation and Extrapolation
detail.abstract: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) have become effective tools for predicting the viscoelastic behavior of polymeric materials. Nevertheless, comparatively few studies have systematically investigated how methodological decisions adopted during ANN development influence training behavior and predictive performance in viscoelastic characterization. This study systematically investigates these methodological aspects using a reference prediction problem for graphite nanoplatelet-reinforced vinyl ester nanocomposites, with graphite nanoplatelet content, loading frequency, and testing temperature as input variables and the storage and loss moduli as output responses. By preserving the same experimental database and ANN architecture — a single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptron (MLP) — throughout the analyses, the individual influence of logarithmic preprocessing, dataset partitioning strategy, hidden-layer topology selection, and validation-based training was objectively assessed. The results demonstrate that logarithmic preprocessing is particularly beneficial when the testing dataset is characterized predominantly by extrapolation, reducing average prediction errors, limiting large prediction deviations, and improving the representation of the experimental variability. Adding up, under predominantly interpolation conditions, its primary contribution is to reduce the number of training epochs required to obtain the representative ANN. Random dataset partitioning substantially improves predictive performance under the original data representation and, when combined with logarithmic preprocessing, accelerates ANN convergence while preserving essentially the same predictive performance. Furthermore, the proposed methodology substantially reduces the hidden-layer size required for convergence while preserving the predictive capability of a classical MLP architecture. Overall, the study establishes practical methodological guidelines for developing reliable and computationally efficient ANN models for viscoelastic characterization, particularly for prediction problems involving highly nonlinear multivariable relationships under interpolation and extrapolation conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了人工神经网络（ANN）开发中的方法学决策（对数预处理、数据集划分策略、隐藏层拓扑选择、基于验证的训练）对粘弹性表征中训练行为和预测性能的影响，为石墨纳米片增强乙烯基酯纳米复合材料提供了实用的方法学指南。
AI.research_question: 在聚合物材料粘弹性表征中，ANN开发过程中的方法学决策（如对数预处理、数据集划分策略、隐藏层拓扑选择和验证训练）如何影响训练行为和预测性能？
AI.motivation: 尽管ANN已成为预测聚合物材料粘弹性行为的有效工具，但很少有研究系统性地探究ANN开发过程中的方法学决策对训练行为和预测性能的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于单隐藏层多层感知器（MLP）架构，结合对数预处理、随机数据集划分、隐藏层拓扑优化和验证训练等方法学要素。
AI.method: 以石墨纳米片增强乙烯基酯纳米复合材料为参考预测问题，以石墨纳米片含量、加载频率和测试温度为输入变量，以储能模量和损耗模量为输出响应。在保持相同实验数据库和ANN架构（单隐藏层MLP）的基础上，客观评估对数预处理、数据集划分策略、隐藏层拓扑选择和基于验证的训练的个体影响。
AI.findings: （1）对数预处理在外推条件下特别有益，可降低平均预测误差、限制大偏差并改善实验变异性的表征；在插值条件下主要减少训练轮数。（2）随机数据集划分在原始数据表示下显著提高预测性能，与对数预处理结合时可加速收敛同时保持预测性能。（3）所提方法可大幅减少收敛所需的隐藏层大小，同时保持经典MLP架构的预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了不同方法学决策在ANN粘弹性表征中的个体影响机制，特别是在插值与外推条件下的差异化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发可靠且计算高效的ANN模型提供了实用的方法学指南，适用于涉及高度非线性多变量关系的预测问题。

title: Where the streets have no car: Causal impact of pedestrianization policies on business performance
affiliations: Université Laval and École supérieure d'aménagement du territoire et de développement régional (ÉSAD)

detail.title: Where the streets have no car: Causal impact of pedestrianization policies on business performance
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the causal impact of pedestrianization policies on business performance, focusing on the probability of remaining open. The city of Dijon (France) is examined, with emphasis on the second wave of pedestrianization implemented between 2001 and 2018 in its historical center. An event study analysis is applied on a panel dataset covering business activity from 2001 to 2019 to identify the causal effects of pedestrianization policies on business performance. While no overall significant effect is found when considering all economic activities, analysis show that restaurants and local services experienced positive effects from pedestrianization. The results suggest that these effects materialized approximately three years after policy implementation and persisted for nearly a decade.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了法国第戎市历史中心在2001年至2018年间实施的第二波步行化政策对企业经营绩效（特别是继续营业的概率）的因果影响。通过事件研究法分析2001-2019年的面板数据，发现整体上步行化政策對所有经济活动无显著影响，但对餐馆和本地服务业有积极效应，且该效应在政策实施约三年后显现并持续近十年。
AI.research_question: 步行化政策对企业经营绩效（特别是继续营业的概率）是否有因果影响？
AI.motivation: 步行化政策在全球城市中日益普及，但其对企业经营的影响尚未得到充分严谨的因果识别。政策制定者需要了解步行化是否会对商家产生负面影响（如客流量减少）或正面影响（如环境改善吸引更多顾客）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法（Event Study Analysis），基于因果推断框架识别政策冲击的长期动态效应。
AI.method: 采用事件研究法分析2001-2019年面板数据，以第戎市历史中心第二波步行化政策（2001-2018年间实施）为准自然实验，比较政策实施前后及不同行业企业的经营表现。
AI.findings: （1）整体上，步行化政策对所有经济活动无显著影响；（2）餐馆和本地服务业从中获得积极效应；（3）该效应在政策实施约三年后显现，并持续近十年。
AI.theory_contributions: 为步行化政策与商业绩效之间的因果关系提供了严密的实证证据，补充了城市经济学和交通政策领域关于步行化经济影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了重要参考：步行化政策不会普遍损害商业，对餐饮和本地服务有长期利好，但效果具有时滞性，需耐心等待约三年才能体现。

title: Learning from Human Feedback for Robotic Recycling under Uncertainty
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Learning from Human Feedback for Robotic Recycling under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Human-AI symbiosis in industrial automation should not be treated as ageneral argument for keeping humans in every automated process. The morefundamental design question is where collaboration between humans and AI isstructurally needed, and where it can be superior to both full automation andmanual work alone. This paper addresses this question through the case ofrobotic recycling. Post-consumer plastic sorting is often approached with thegoal of automating as much as possible, because manual sorting is physicallydemanding, unpleasant, and difficult to scale. However, participatory fieldworkin lightweight packaging sorting facilities shows that sorting work is not astable, repetitive pick-and-place task. Workers continuously adapt toheterogeneous material streams, changing waste sources, weather-dependent anddamaged object conditions, conveyor dynamics, disruptions, and varying economicvalue. The resulting industrial allocation pattern is often binary: selectedsubtasks are automated as far as possible, while the remaining work is left tohumans as residual manual work, a pattern previously discussed as"left-over allocation''.Building on this diagnosis, we argue that robotic recycling is a genuinehuman-AI symbiosis problem. A recycling robot must commit to a pick at aspecific moment in time, although material identity, graspability,contamination risk, downstream value, and future waste-stream composition areonly partially known. Human operators, meanwhile, possess tacit and situatedknowledge about which objects are worth picking, which objects are risky, andwhen the sorting strategy should change. We therefore propose anRLHF-inspired operator-prior architecture for RecycleBot. The approachformulates robotic sorting as a value-aware decision problemand combines a learned action-value model with a human-derived behavioralprior. The resulting KL-regularized policy treats human expertise not as afallback after automation fails, but as a structured prior over robot actions.A rolling assignment layer extends the formulation to short-horizon planningunder robot-capacity constraints. Synthetic multi-seed experiments show thatthe operator-prior policy performs best of all compared policies early in arun, avoids the run-to-run failures of unregularized value learning, andreduces the number of decisions requiring human correction by a factor offive to seven, at a cost in long-run reward that the KL temperature controlsdirectly. The contribution is analgorithmic and architectural pathway from automation-as-replacement towardadaptive human-robot collaboration in industrial recycling which can be adapted to other domains with high variability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受RLHF启发的人类-AI协同架构（RecycleBot），将操作员经验作为结构化先验嵌入机器人决策，在工业回收领域实现了比纯自动化或纯人工更优的柔性人机协作模式，并将人工干预需求降低了5-7倍。
AI.research_question: 在哪些工业自动化场景中，人机协作在结构上是必需的，并且可以优于完全自动化或纯人工操作？具体而言，如何设计机器人回收中的自适应人机协作架构？
AI.motivation: 工业自动化中"尽可能自动化"的默认思路忽视了人类在高度变异环境中的不可替代的隐性知识；现有"剩余分配"模式（将自动化做不了的留给人类）造成割裂而非协同。回收分拣恰恰是一个高度不确定、需要人类情境判断的场景，因此是研究真正人机协同的绝佳案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）、KL-正则化策略、价值感知决策问题、行动-价值模型、行为先验、滚动分配（rolling assignment）
AI.method: 参与式田野调查（在轻质包装分拣设施中）、RLHF启发的operator-prior架构设计、合成多种子实验（synthetic multi-seed experiments）比较不同策略的表现
AI.findings: (1) 回收分拣工作并非稳定的重复性任务，工人需持续适应高度异质的物料流；(2) 当前行业多为"剩余分配"二元模式；(3) 提出的operator-prior策略在早期表现最优，避免了未正则化价值学习的"run-to-run"失败；(4) 需要人工纠正的决策数量降低了5-7倍，长期奖励可通过KL温度参数直接控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"人类经验作为结构化先验"而非"自动化失败后的备选"的理论视角，将人机协同问题重新定义为价值感知决策问题，并引入KL-正则化框架进行形式化建模。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了从"自动化替代"到"自适应人机协作"的算法与架构路径，可推广到其他高变异性工业领域；显著降低了人工干预频率（5-7倍），提高了系统在实际工业环境中的可行性。

title: Predicting inter-city expressway traffic flow by integrating OTC data, graph neural networks, and urban geographical context
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Predicting inter-city expressway traffic flow by integrating OTC data, graph neural networks, and urban geographical context

keywords: Big Data of Expressway Traffic Flow

detail.abstract: Expressway transportation facilitates the movement of population, goods, and other elements between cities, which directly reflects the underlying inter-city interactions. Predicting inter-city expressway traffic flows represents an important direction in the development of macro-scale traffic flow prediction models and has significant practical implications for urban transportation planning and coordinated regional development. Guided by mobility theory, this study utilizes expressway online toll collection (OTC) data from 2020 to 2025 and integrates graph neural network models with urban geographical context to innovatively propose an inter-city expressway traffic flow prediction model (IE-Fpre). The main findings are as follows: (1) The IE-Fpre model demonstrates an effective architecture design. The graph convolutional network (GCN) embedded in the IE-Fpre model achieved an R2 value of 0.861 and an MAE of 2982, outperforming the graph attention network (GAT) and GraphSAGE. Moreover, the two-layer GCN architecture demonstrated superior performance compared with both single-layer and three-layer structures. Ablation experiments demonstrate that incorporating urban geographical context information and OTC directed traffic flow big data significantly enhances the capability of the IE-Fpre model to characterize urban traffic radiation and attraction potentials. (2) The IE-Fpre model exhibits stable training behavior. The training and validation loss curves under different cross-validation folds showed no significant divergence or late-stage rebound, indicating that the IE-Fpre model did not suffer from overfitting. Furthermore, comparative experiments involving 13 representative machine learning and deep learning models showed that the IE-Fpre model achieved MAE, RMSE, and R2 values of 0.1959, 0.4426, and 0.9179, respectively, ranking first across all three metrics and demonstrating superior predictive performance and generalization capability. (3) A case study in Guangdong Province, China, demonstrates that the IE-Fpre model achieves high prediction accuracy. The predicted network for 2025 maintained good consistency with the observed networks from 2020 to 2024, continuing the evolutionary trend of ”stable cores and strengthened peripheries.” Furthermore, the predicted and observed networks in 2025 exhibited high similarity in terms of network spatial structure, node characteristics, and edge connections. The coefficient of determination R2 between predicted and observed node values reached 0.89, while that for edge flows reached 0.88. In summary, from the perspective of directed weighted urban network structure prediction, the proposed IE-Fpre model addresses the challenge of inter-city traffic flow prediction, expands the application of artificial intelligence technologies in the field of traffic flow forecasting, and provides decision-support for for future policy formulation related to transportation collaborative governance and urban integrated development.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于移动性理论，利用高速公路联网收费数据和图神经网络，提出了一个城际高速公路交通流预测模型（IE-Fpre），在广东省案例中表现优异，预测R²达到0.88-0.89，解决了城际交通流预测难题。
AI.research_question: 如何利用图神经网络和城市地理上下文信息，构建一个有效的城际高速公路交通流预测模型？
AI.motivation: 城际高速公路交通流直接反映城市间交互，预测这类交通流对宏观交通模型发展和区域规划具重要意义，但现有研究缺乏有效的城际尺度预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动性理论（Mobility Theory）
AI.method: 提出IE-Fpre模型，融合图卷积网络（GCN）与城市地理上下文信息，利用2020-2025年高速公路联网收费数据（OTC）进行建模和预测。
AI.findings: (1) IE-Fpre模型架构设计有效，两层GCN优于GAT和GraphSAGE；(2) 模型训练稳定，无过拟合；(3) 与13个基准模型对比，IE-Fpre在MAE(0.1959)、RMSE(0.4426)、R²(0.9179)三项指标均排名第一；(4) 广东案例中预测与观测网络的R²达0.89（节点）和0.88（边流）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将移动性理论引入城际交通流预测，从有向加权城市网络结构预测的角度拓展了AI技术在交通流预测领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通规划、区域协调发展以及交通协同治理政策制定提供决策支持。

title: More Help, Less Care?,Adult Children and the Limits of Family Old-Age Insurance in China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: More Help, Less Care?,Adult Children and the Limits of Family Old-Age Insurance in China
detail.abstract: Adult children are often used, in research and policy, as evidence that older parents have informal old-age insurance. This paper examines what that insurance covers. I use child-level panel data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study over the 2013–2015, 2015–2018, and 2013–2018 survey intervals, linking parents' stated expectations about which child would help them to later support from each child. The empirical comparison is between siblings observed for the same parent over the same survey interval. I separate support that requires presence—hands-on care and local availability—from support that can travel—financial transfers and communication. More named expected helpers greatly reduce the chance that no named child provides any support. It does not, however, raise the probability that a parent has someone providing care or living nearby, a parent-level result that holds across all families naming at least one child. In sibling comparisons where named and unnamed children coexist, the named-child premium in care and local availability is smaller in multiple-helper systems, while the premium in financial and other divisible support is larger. Care from named children becomes more likely when parental health deteriorates, consistent with a standby form of responsibility rather than a routine one. These patterns remain after adding controls for baseline same-form support, and the estimates describe prospective within-family associations rather than causal effects of naming. Child-based measures of old-age security therefore overstate protection against care risk: families covered in money can remain uninsured in presence.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，成年子女作为父母非正式养老保障的证据，主要覆盖的是金钱等可转移支持，而非需要亲身在场的照护。在多子女家庭中，被父母指定为潜在照顾者的子女确实更可能提供经济支持，但在提供照护和就近居住方面优势有限，且当父母健康恶化时，指定子女的照护响应才明显增强。
AI.research_question: 成年子女作为父母的非正式养老保障，究竟覆盖了哪些风险？具体而言，子女提供的支持中，哪些是需要亲身在场的（照护、就近居住），哪些是可以远程实现的（经济转移、通讯），两者有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现有研究和政策常将"有子女"等同于父母拥有非正式养老保障，但不同类型的支持（如金钱与照护）具有不同属性。本文旨在区分这些支持类型，检验子女保障的真实覆盖范围，揭示家庭养老保障的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正式养老保障理论、家庭内部资源分配理论、"待命责任"（standby responsibility）与常规责任的区别。
AI.method: 使用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）2013-2015、2015-2018、2013-2018三个区间的子代面板数据，将父母对哪个子女会帮助自己的预期陈述与后期实际获得的支持进行匹配，采用同一父母多个子女之间的兄弟姐妹比较（sibling comparison）方法。
AI.findings: 1. 指定更多预期帮助子女能显著降低"无任何子女提供支持"的概率，但未能提高父母有人提供照护或就近居住的概率。2. 在指定与未指定子女共存的多子女家庭中，指定子女在照护和就近居住上的"指定溢价"较小，而在经济等可分性支持上的溢价较大。3. 当父母健康恶化时，来自指定子女的照护更可能出现，符合"待命责任"而非常规责任模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"可旅行支持"与"需在场支持"两类家庭养老支持，揭示了非正式养老保障在照护风险方面的覆盖缺口，丰富了家庭养老保障有效性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和研究者，基于子女数量的养老保障评估会高估对照护风险的保护：家庭在金钱上可能得到保障，但在"在场"照护方面仍可能处于无保障状态。这对养老政策设计、社会保障体系补位具有重要启示。

title: An Exploratory Factor Analysis of Tourist Behavior, Public Transport Accessibility, Community Participation, and Destination Attractiveness in Religious Tourism Routes: Evidence from Dusit District, Bangkok, Thailand
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Exploratory Factor Analysis of Tourist Behavior, Public Transport Accessibility, Community Participation, and Destination Attractiveness in Religious Tourism Routes: Evidence from Dusit District, Bangkok, Thailand
detail.abstract: Religious tourism has become an important component of urban cultural tourism, yet limited research has examined the underlying dimensions shaping tourists’ perceptions and behaviors in urban religious tourism routes. This study investigates the factor structure of tourist behavior, public transport accessibility, community participation, and destination attractiveness in religious tourism routes within Dusit District, Bangkok, Thailand. A quantitative cross-sectional survey was conducted among 400 tourists using a cluster sampling approach. Data were collected through structured questionnaires and analyzed using Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) and reliability testing. The results confirmed the suitability of the data for factor analysis and identified five distinct factors: Behavioral Intention, Perceived Community Participation, Perceived Accessibility by Public Transport, Travel Behavior, and Perceived Destination Attractiveness. Together, these factors explained 66.12% of the total variance, with Cronbach’s alpha coefficients ranging from .78 to .87, indicating satisfactory internal consistency. Notably, attitude did not emerge as an independent factor, suggesting that tourists evaluate religious tourism routes primarily through destination attractiveness and future behavioral tendencies. The findings extend the conceptual application of the Theory of Planned Behavior by identifying contextual dimensions relevant to urban religious tourism settings. Practically, the results highlight the importance of improving public transport accessibility, strengthening community participation, and enhancing destination attractiveness to support sustainable religious tourism development. The identified factor structure provides a foundation for future confirmatory research and tourism planning in urban heritage destinations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过探索性因子分析，在曼谷都实区的宗教旅游路线中识别出五个关键因子（行为意向、社区参与感知、公共交通可达性感知、旅行行为、目的地吸引力感知），解释了66.12%的总方差，并扩展了计划行为理论在宗教旅游情境下的应用。
AI.research_question: 城市宗教旅游路线中塑造游客感知和行为的基础维度（因子结构）是什么？
AI.motivation: 宗教旅游已成为城市文化旅游的重要组成部分，但关于城市宗教旅游路线中游客感知与行为的潜在维度研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior, TPB）
AI.method: 定量横截面调查；对400名游客采用整群抽样；通过结构化问卷收集数据；使用探索性因子分析（EFA）和信度检验进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 提取出五个因子（行为意向、社区参与感知、公共交通可达性感知、旅行行为、目的地吸引力感知），解释66.12%总方差；Cronbach's α系数在0.78-0.87之间；态度未作为独立因子出现，表明游客主要通过目的地吸引力和未来行为倾向来评估宗教旅游路线。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了计划行为理论在城市宗教旅游情境中的概念应用，识别出与城市宗教旅游环境相关的特定维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调改善公共交通可达性、加强社区参与以及提升目的地吸引力对可持续宗教旅游发展的重要性；为未来验证性研究和城市遗产地旅游规划提供了因子结构基础。

title: Socio-economic, environmental, and irrigation water management challenges in rice production in Nyamugari marshland of Rwanda
affiliations: Rwanda Polytechnic, Rwanda Polytechnic, Rwanda Polytechnic and Rwanda Polytechnic

detail.title: Socio-economic, environmental, and irrigation water management challenges in rice production in Nyamugari marshland of Rwanda
detail.abstract: Rwanda continues to experience a rice production deficit, meeting only about 45% of national rice consumption needs. Marshland areas such as Nyamugari, though are prioritised in national and district-level development policies, contribute insufficiently due to persistent agronomic, socio-economic, and infrastructural constraints. This study assessed the factors (such as gender, age, education level, marital status, water source, water scarcity, availability of irrigation tools, improved agricultural technologies, use of fertiliser and quality seeds, farmer general knowledge, government and private sector intervention) affecting rice cultivation in Nyamugari Marshland, Southern Province of Rwanda, from transplanting to - harvesting. Data were collected through structured farmer surveys and analysed using Spearman correlation in IBM SPSS 29 and Origin Pro 2025. Results showed that water availability and irrigation practices were significantly associated with rice yield, underscoring the importance of integrated water resource management adaptation. The use of fertilisers and quality seeds, and training on water management. also positively correlated with rice yields. Socio-demographic factors, particularly age, education level, and marital status, significantly influenced farming efficiency and access to resources, with younger, educated, and unmarried farmers showing greater adaptability, while older and married farmers faced financial constraints the most. Government and community-led initiatives were linked to improved irrigation infrastructure and farmer support, though with varying effectiveness. In contrast, gender and general agricultural knowledge showed no significant associations with rice yields. These findings highlight the need for targeted, locally adapted interventions to improve rice production in Nyamugari Marshland.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了卢旺达Nyamugari沼泽地水稻种植的影响因素，发现水资源可用性、灌溉实践、化肥与优质种子的使用以及水分管理培训与水稻产量显著正相关，而性别和一般农业知识则无显著关联。
AI.research_question: 影响卢旺达Nyamugari沼泽地水稻种植的关键因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 卢旺达持续面临大米生产赤字，仅能满足约45%的国内消费需求。Nyamugari沼泽地虽被列为优先发展区域，但因农艺、社会经济和基础设施等多重约束，贡献不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业生产力影响因素理论，涵盖社会人口学因素（性别、年龄、教育、婚姻状况）、资源获取因素（水源、灌溉工具、改良技术、肥料与优质种子）、知识因素（农民一般知识、水分管理培训）以及外部干预因素（政府与私营部门介入）。
AI.method: 通过结构化农户调查收集数据，采用Spearman相关分析，使用IBM SPSS 29和Origin Pro 2025进行数据分析。
AI.findings: (1) 水资源可用性和灌溉实践与水稻产量显著相关；(2) 肥料和优质种子的使用、水分管理培训与产量正相关；(3) 年龄、教育水平和婚姻状况显著影响种植效率和资源获取，年轻、受教育程度高和未婚农户适应性更强，年长和已婚农户面临更多财务约束；(4) 政府和社区主导的举措改善了灌溉基础设施和农户支持，但效果不一；(5) 性别和一般农业知识与水稻产量无显著关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在非洲沼泽地农业情境下，水资源管理和灌溉实践相较于社会人口学因素（如性别）对水稻产量的更强解释力，丰富了小农农业生产力影响因素的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达及类似地区的政策制定者和农业推广机构提供了针对性干预建议：应重点加强水资源综合管理、肥料和优质种子推广、农民水分管理培训，并关注不同年龄和教育水平农户的差异化需求。

title: A Study on the Application of Alternative Data in Credit Assessment for the Unbanked Population
affiliations: Georgetown University,  and Renming University of China

detail.title: A Study on the Application of Alternative Data in Credit Assessment for the Unbanked Population
detail.abstract: Borrowers without credit cards or loan borrowing history (referred to as "credit-invisible") are generally unable to produce credit scores in the conventional credit reporting system.
