This means they are either automatically declined or must accept subprime loans. To address the issue of loan approval for this group, this study uses real subprime auto loan application data from 2021 to 2023, including a training sample of 50, 000 observations and a test sample of 20, 000 observations, and adds alternative data (such as rent payment history, utility bills and telecommunication bills). The study set up a baseline model with only traditional credit information, as well as alternative data logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost models and performed a simultaneous assessment of both loan approval rates, 12-month default rates, and fairness indicators. The findings indicate that following the introduction of the alternative data, the approval rate of "credit-invisible" customers increased by 22.1%, while the default rate increased by only 0.4 percentage points, and the increase was not significant. Feature importance tests show that timely rent payments, the number of timely bill payments and long-term consistency in phone numbers are important complementary factors in determining the repayment capacity of credit invisible borrowers. Additional fairness tests also show no evidence of worsened demographic equity and equal opportunity for racial and income minorities. The proposed approach in this paper provides broader financial service coverage compared to the conventional credit-risk assessment practices that rely on credit scores, while addressing the risk spillover problem caused by a sole emphasis on approval rates. The paper shows that alternative data can not only provide additional information to supplement the lack of traditional credit information, but can also play a critical role in enhancing financial inclusion and refining the risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2021-2023年次级汽车贷款数据，在传统信用信息基础上加入替代数据（如租金支付记录、水电费和电信账单），使用逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型进行建模。结果显示，引入替代数据后，"信用隐形"客户的贷款批准率提高了22.1%，而违约率仅上升0.4个百分点（不显著）。特征重要性分析表明，按时支付租金、按时支付账单次数以及电话号码的长期稳定性是评估该类客户还款能力的重要补充因素。公平性测试未发现对人口统计公平性和种族、收入少数群体的平等机会有显著恶化。
AI.research_question: 如何利用替代数据（如租金、水电费、电信账单等非传统信用信息）来为"信用隐形"群体（无信用卡或贷款记录的人群）提供更准确的贷款审批决策，同时兼顾风险控制和公平性？
AI.motivation: 传统信用评分系统无法为"信用隐形"群体生成信用分数，导致该群体要么被自动拒绝贷款，要么只能接受次级贷款。为解决这一金融排斥问题，需要探索替代数据能否有效补充传统信用信息的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险评估理论、金融包容性理论、替代数据信用评估框架
AI.method: 使用2021-2023年真实次级汽车贷款申请数据（训练样本50,000条，测试样本20,000条），建立仅含传统信用信息的基线模型，以及加入替代数据的逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型，同时对贷款批准率、12个月违约率和公平性指标进行联合评估。
AI.findings: 1) 引入替代数据后，"信用隐形"客户批准率提高22.1%，违约率仅上升0.4个百分点（不显著）；2) 按时支付租金、按时支付账单次数和电话号码长期稳定性是重要的补充评估因素；3) 公平性测试未发现对种族和收入少数群体的歧视加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了替代数据在补充传统信用信息不足方面的有效性，拓展了信用风险评估的理论框架，证明了替代数据可以在不显著增加违约风险的前提下提升金融包容性，同时为解决"信用隐形"群体的信贷难题提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了一套可操作的替代数据信用评估方法，可以在扩大金融服务覆盖面的同时控制风险溢出；为政策制定者推动金融包容性改革提供了实证支持；为"信用隐形"群体获得公平信贷机会提供了现实路径。

title: Giant Bamboo vs. Acacia: Carbon, Ecosystem Services, and Economic Performance in Vietnamese Plantation Forestry

detail.title: Giant Bamboo vs. Acacia: Carbon, Ecosystem Services, and Economic Performance in Vietnamese Plantation Forestry
detail.abstract: Tropical plantation forestry in Southeast Asia relies heavily on short-rotation Acacia hybrid monocultures, which offer limited carbon sequestration and accelerate soil degradation. Giant Bamboo (Dendrocalamus giganteus EB1) is a promising alternative crop that delivers superior economic and ecological outcomes. This study applies the Integrated Sustainable Forestry Value (ISFV) framework to compare Giant Bamboo against Acacia hybrid over a 20-year horizon in Central Vietnam. The analysis utilizes IPCC Tier 3 field measurements from a 2.59-hectare trial plantation. The results demonstrate that bamboo achieves an internal rate of return (IRR) of 31-33% compared to 22-24% for Acacia, and generates a total ISFV of 3,462 M VND/ha versus 727 M VND/ha. Furthermore, bamboo outperforms Acacia across all ISFV sub-components, including carbon credit value, ecosystem services, external cost reduction, and social value. At a national scale of 500,000 hectares, this transition fulfills 41.6% of Vietnam's LULUCF NDC target and supports approximately 500,000 full-time livelihoods. This paper treats the baseline financial parameters as indicative benchmarks subject to multi-site replication, and presents the nationalscale figures as illustrative policy scenarios rather than empirical projections.

AI.tldr: 本文运用综合可持续林业价值（ISFV）框架，比较了越南中部巨竹与相思树杂交种在20年周期内的表现。结果表明，巨竹在内部收益率（31-33% vs 22-24%）、总ISFV（3,462 M VND/ha vs 727 M VND/ha）以及碳信用价值、生态系统服务、外部成本降低和社会价值等所有子指标上均优于相思树。若在全国50万公顷范围内推广，可实现越南LULUCF国家自主贡献目标的41.6%，并支撑约50万个全职生计。
AI.research_question: 在东南亚热带人工林种植中，巨竹（Dendrocalamus giganteus EB1）作为短周期相思树杂交种单一种植的替代方案，能否在20年周期内提供更优的经济和生态综合价值？
AI.motivation: 东南亚热带人工林过度依赖短周期相思树杂交种单一种植，导致碳汇能力有限、土壤退化加剧。寻找既能提升经济回报又能改善生态可持续性的替代作物具有重要的实践和政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合可持续林业价值（Integrated Sustainable Forestry Value, ISFV）框架，该框架整合了碳信用价值、生态系统服务、外部成本降低和社会价值等多个维度。
AI.method: 采用IPCC Tier 3方法，在越南中部2.59公顷试验种植园进行实地测量；运用ISFV框架进行综合价值评估；财务分析采用内部收益率（IRR）指标；并基于50万公顷规模进行政策情景模拟。
AI.findings: （1）巨竹的内部收益率为31-33%，显著高于相思树的22-24%；（2）巨竹的总ISFV为3,462 M VND/ha，远高于相思树的727 M VND/ha；（3）巨竹在所有ISFV子指标（碳信用价值、生态系统服务、外部成本降低、社会价值）上均优于相思树；（4）全国50万公顷推广可贡献越南LULUCF国家自主贡献目标的41.6%，并支撑约50万个全职生计。
AI.theory_contributions: 为综合可持续林业价值（ISFV）框架在热带人工林替代作物评估中的应用提供了实证支持，拓展了该框架在碳汇林业和生态系统服务综合评估中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南及东南亚地区以巨竹替代相思树人工林提供了有力的经济和生态数据支撑；为政策制定者实现国家自主贡献（NDC）目标和促进农村就业提供了可操作的路径参考；同时注意指出了基线参数的指示性局限和政策情景的说明性性质。

title: Disentangling Behavioral Drivers of Household Solar Photovoltaic Adoption in an Emerging Economy: Evidence from Nepal
affiliations: Hainan University

detail.title: Disentangling Behavioral Drivers of Household Solar Photovoltaic Adoption in an Emerging Economy: Evidence from Nepal
detail.abstract: Household adoption of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems is a central lever in the sustainable energy transition, yet in many emerging economies uptake remains low even where solar resources are abundant and public subsidies exist. This paper takes Nepal as a strategic case, a country with one of South Asia’s strongest solar resource bases and persistent low household adoption, to examine the behavioral determinants that supply-side policy analyses miss. Drawing on an integrated Technology Acceptance Model, Theory of Planned Behavior, and Diffusion of Innovation framework extended with Value-Belief-Norm theory, we test six context-specific determinants of household adoption decisions: trust in solar, quality of solar installations and installers, knowledge of incentives, knowledge of SPV systems, investment opportunity, and environmental values. Survey data from 321 households, both adopters and non-adopters, across four districts of Lumbini Province were analyzed using PLS-SEM. All six hypotheses were supported, and the model explains 58.4% of the variance in adoption decisions. Investment opportunity is the strongest predictor (β = 0.298), followed by knowledge of SPV systems (β = 0.241): households adopt when they can frame solar PV as a sound financial asset and understand the technology well enough to trust that framing. Installation quality (β = 0.187), environmental values (β = 0.174), incentive knowledge (β = 0.163), and trust in solar (β = 0.152) also carry significant weight. The study contributes to sustainable consumption research by validating an integrated four-theory behavioral framework in a previously unexamined emerging-economy context.

AI.tldr: 本研究以尼泊尔为案例，整合TAM、TPB、DOI和VBN四大理论框架，通过321户家庭调查数据发现：投资机会是家庭采用太阳能光伏的最强预测因子，其次是系统知识，模型解释了58.4%的采用决策变异。
AI.research_question: 在太阳能资源丰富且存在公共补贴的新兴经济体中，为什么家庭太阳能光伏采用率仍然很低？其行为决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有政策分析主要关注供给侧因素，忽视了对家庭采用决策的行为决定因素的理解。尼泊尔作为南亚太阳能资源最丰富的国家之一，家庭采用率却持续偏低，是检验这些行为因素的理想案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了技术接受模型（TAM）、计划行为理论（TPB）、创新扩散理论（DOI）以及价值-信念-规范理论（VBN）的扩展框架，提出了六个情境化的行为决定因素。
AI.method: 采用PLS-SEM（偏最小二乘结构方程模型）分析来自尼泊尔蓝毗尼省四个地区321户家庭（包括采用者和非采用者）的调查数据。
AI.findings: 所有六个假设均得到支持，模型解释力达58.4%。最强预测因子为投资机会（β=0.298），其次为系统知识（β=0.241）、安装质量（β=0.187）、环境价值观（β=0.174）、激励知识（β=0.163）和信任（β=0.152）。
AI.theory_contributions: 在先前未被考察的新兴经济体情境中，验证了一个整合四理论的综合性行为分析框架，为可持续消费研究提供了理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的行为杠杆点：强调投资回报的经济叙事、提升技术知识普及、改善安装质量管控，以促进太阳能光伏在发展中经济体的家庭推广。

title: Mitigating Price Spikes in Electricity Markets with Reserve Power Plants: Case Study on Germany Within the European Market
affiliations: University of Technology Nuremberg, University of Technology Nuremberg, University of Technology Nuremberg, University of Technology Nuremberg and

detail.title: Mitigating Price Spikes in Electricity Markets with Reserve Power Plants: Case Study on Germany Within the European Market
detail.abstract: Several European countries hold a substantial share of conventional generation capacity deliberately outside the electricity market as strategic reserve. These reserve power plants are often older units and only activated under exceptional conditions to ensure resource adequacy during severe scarcity situations. Recent policy discussions, motivated by concerns about frequent price spikes and their economic implications, consider allowing a temporary participation of reserve power plants in the electricity spot market. This paper analyzes the effects of such a policy within Germany on market outcomes and investment decisions in generation capacity, battery storage, and electrolysis in the European electricity market. To this end, we employ an electricity market model for the European electricity system in 2030 that endogenously determines investments, decommissioning, generation, storage operation, and hydrogen production. Reserve power plants are allowed to participate in the spot market whenever a predefined strike price is reached or exceeded. The analyzed scenarios are exogenously specified and vary with respect to the strike price and the volume of reserve capacity available for market participation. All results are evaluated in relation to a reference scenario without reserve power plant utilization. We find that allowing reserve power plants to enter the spot market can substantially reduce peak prices during scarcity periods. However, these short-term price reductions weaken scarcity signals and thereby reduce investment incentives, leading to a lower capacity expansion. As a result, prices increase in non-scarcity periods. In addition, the policy induces spillover effects in neighboring countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究德国允许战略储备电厂临时参与电力现货市场的政策效果。通过欧洲电力系统模型（2030年情景）分析发现：该政策虽能在短缺时期大幅降低峰值电价，但会削弱稀缺信号、抑制投资激励，导致非短缺时期电价上升，并产生跨国溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 允许战略储备电厂临时参与电力现货市场对市场结果、发电容量投资、电池储能及电解制氢投资决策有何影响？
AI.motivation: 近期政策讨论因担忧频繁电价飙升及其经济影响，考虑允许储备电厂临时参与现货市场，但该政策的系统性影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力市场稀缺定价理论、投资激励与稀缺信号关系、容量投资决策理论、跨国电力市场溢出效应理论
AI.method: 采用欧洲电力系统模型（2030年情景），内生决定投资、退役、发电、储能运行及制氢，设置不同执行价和储备容量规模的情景，与无储备电厂参与的基准情景对比。
AI.findings: 1. 储备电厂入市可大幅降低短缺期峰值电价；2. 但短期降价削弱稀缺信号，降低投资激励，导致容量扩张减少；3. 非短缺时期电价因此上升；4. 政策对邻国产生溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了储备电厂临时入市政策在短期价格稳定与长期投资激励之间的根本权衡，补充了稀缺定价理论在政策干预情境下的适用性边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德国及欧洲政策制定者提供实证依据，表明允许储备电厂入市虽能缓解短期价格压力，但会损害长期容量充足性，需谨慎设计政策参数。

title: A Reproducible R-Based Framework for Interactive Cultural Landscape Mapping Using Image-Embedded Administrative Open Data: A Case Study of Fukui Furusato Hyakkei, Japan
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: A Reproducible R-Based Framework for Interactive Cultural Landscape Mapping Using Image-Embedded Administrative Open Data: A Case Study of Fukui Furusato Hyakkei, Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or animals, as it relies entirely on the analysis of publicly available administrative open data.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or nonprofit sectors.

detail.abstract: We present a robust and reproducible R-based framework for constructing an interactive web map of “Fukui Furusato Hyakkei” (One Hundred Landscapes of Fukui), a cultural landscape preservation initiative in Fukui Prefecture, Japan. The administrative open dataset comprises 100 historically, culturally, and naturally significant sites linked to geographic coordinates and official image URLs. Leveraging the R leaflet package, the framework renders each site as a geolocated marker with a pop-up card displaying an embedded photograph retrieved from the administrative URL, creating a multimedia GIS environment that integrates open government data and spatial humanities. The software addresses three challenges in Japanese administrative open data: CP932/Shift-JIS character encoding incompatible with modern web- and Linux-based environments; inverted latitude–longitude coordinates in specific records, corrected through an idempotent algorithm that ensures forward compatibility with future upstream corrections; and invisible carriage return characters and whitespace that corrupt URL strings in strict WebAssembly (ShinyLive/WebR) environments, resolved through trimws() and gsub() sanitization. A CSS-based pre-dimensioning technique with auto-pan padding control eliminates a common leaflet popup image embedding defect, enabling a seamless card-style display. The framework integrates dynamic attribution compliant with official licensing requirements and supports layer switching between the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) Standard Map and GSI satellite imagery. All source code and the cleaned dataset are openly available on Zenodo, and a live demonstration is accessible. The architecture provides a reusable template for regional analysis, Digital Humanities, and evidence-informed local governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于R语言的稳健可复现框架，用于构建福井县"百景"文化遗产景观的交互式网络地图，解决了日本行政开放数据中的编码、坐标颠倒和URL清洗等三大技术挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何利用R语言leaflet包和日本行政开放数据，构建一个稳健、可复现的交互式网络地图，以展示和保存福井县的文化景观遗产？
AI.motivation: 日本行政开放数据存在CP932字符编码兼容性差、经纬度坐标颠倒、URL字符串含不可见字符等技术问题，缺乏一个系统性的、可复现的框架来整合这些数据用于数字人文与区域研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字人文（Digital Humanities）、空间人文（Spatial Humanities）、多媒体GIS（Multimedia GIS）、开放政府数据（Open Government Data）
AI.method: 基于R语言leaflet包构建交互式网络地图；通过idempotent算法纠正坐标颠倒；使用trimws()和gsub()清洗URL字符串；采用CSS预尺寸化技术解决Leaflet弹窗图片嵌入缺陷。
AI.findings: 成功构建了福井百景交互式地图，包含100个地标点、嵌入官方图像、支持GSI标准地图与卫星地图切换，解决了三大数据技术挑战，所有代码和清洗数据集已开源发布。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字人文与空间人文领域提供了一个处理日本行政开放数据的技术解决方案框架，展示了如何将非标准化政府数据转化为可复现的互动可视化成果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可复用的模板，适用于区域分析、数字人文研究和基于证据的地方治理；所有代码和数据已开源（Zenodo），并有在线演示可供体验。

title: Models with Financial Intermediation and Optimal Long-Run Unconventional Monetary Policy
affiliations: University of Ottawa - Department of Economics

detail.title: Models with Financial Intermediation and Optimal Long-Run Unconventional Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper revisits the influential frameworks developed by Gertler-Kiyotaki and their coauthors to understand the 2007 financial crisis and assess unconventional monetary policy. While adopting their core structural assumptions, it reexamines the steady-state implications of financial frictions and the design of optimal unconventional interventions in a simplified real economy setting. The analysis reveals that key financial sector variables-including the cost of capital for intermediaries-are entirely determined within the financial sector and remain independent of production sectors. It characterizes Ramsey-optimal policy under both inelastic and endogenous labor supply and uncovers a counterintuitive result: the optimal scale of central bank asset purchases increases with the efficiency cost of intervention. The model also admits multiple Ramsey-optimal equilibria under plausible parameter values. These findings raise questions about the internal logic and the soundness of the optimal policy implications of these frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了Gertler-Kiyotaki及其合作者关于2007年金融危机与非常规货币政策的研究框架，发现金融摩擦的稳态含义及最优干预政策设计中存在若干反直觉结果与多重均衡问题，对该框架的内在逻辑和政策含义的合理性提出了质疑。
AI.research_question: Gertler-Kiyotaki框架中金融摩擦的稳态含义是什么？最优非常规干预政策应如何设计？该框架的内部逻辑是否一致？
AI.motivation: Gertler-Kiyotaki框架在金融危机分析和非常规货币政策评估中被广泛使用，但其稳态含义和最优政策设计尚未被充分检验，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gertler-Kiyotaki金融加速器模型；Ramsey最优政策框架；一般均衡下的金融摩擦与资产购买分析。
AI.method: 在简化实体经济环境中，采用稳态分析与Ramsey最优政策框架，分别考察劳动力供给无弹性和内生弹性情形下的最优政策设计。
AI.findings: （1）关键金融变量（如金融中介资本成本）完全由金融部门内部决定，与生产部门无关；（2）央行资产购买的最优规模随干预效率成本上升而增加（反直觉）；（3）在合理参数下存在多重Ramsey最优均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Gertler-Kiyotaki框架中金融部门与实体部门的脱节问题；发现了反直觉的最优政策结果；指出了模型存在多重均衡的内部不一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对基于该框架制定非常规货币政策的实践者提出警示：该模型的最优政策建议可能不可靠，需谨慎使用。

title: Mapping the Right against Rights in Latin America: A Database of Right-wing Mobilization in Seven Countries and Transnational Actors
affiliations: School of Social Work, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile and University of Oxford

detail.title: Mapping the Right against Rights in Latin America: A Database of Right-wing Mobilization in Seven Countries and Transnational Actors

declarations.ethicsApproval: This project was approved by and conducted under the UK's CUREC ethical standards.

detail.abstract: Right-wing mobilization in Latin America remains understudied relative to Europe and the United States. This article introduces the Right against Rights (RAR) Database, the first systematic cross-national dataset of right-wing civil society actors in the Global South. It documents 792 organizations and individuals across seven Latin American countries and transnational networks, coded on 35 variables, and classifies actors as countermovements, uncivil movements, or radical neoliberal mobilizations. The database makes two contributions. It integrates actor types typically studied in isolation. It captures the full range of right-wing extra-institutional action, usually overlooked in Latin American scholarship. Key findings reveal a larger, more diverse, and more durable movement ecosystem than prior scholarship assumed. Gender and sexuality form the central axes of contention, and the three types are empirically distinguishable yet exhibit complex overlaps. The database challenges core assumptions about the Latin American right and provides a foundation for comparative, longitudinal, and cross-regional research.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个系统性的全球南方右翼公民社会行为者跨国数据集（RAR数据库），涵盖7个拉美国家792个组织和个体，揭示了比以往研究更大、更多元、更持久的右翼运动生态系统，并指出性别与性取向是核心争议轴线。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲的右翼公民社会动员呈现怎样的特征？其类型学差异与重叠如何？
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲的右翼动员研究相对于欧美学界严重不足，且现有研究零散、缺乏系统性跨国家数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 右翼公民社会行为者的三分法分类框架：反向运动（countermovements）、非文明运动（uncivil movements）和激进新自由主义动员（radical neoliberal mobilizations）。
AI.method: 系统数据集的构建：涵盖7个拉美国家、792个组织/个体、35个变量的编码，并进行跨国家、跨国网络的系统性分类与统计分析。
AI.findings: （1）拉美右翼运动生态系统比以往认知更大、更多元、更持久；（2）性别与性取向是核心争议轴线；（3）三种类型在经验上可区分但存在复杂重叠。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于拉丁美洲右翼的核心假设；整合了通常被孤立研究的行动者类型；捕捉了学界通常忽视的制度外右翼行动全貌；为比较研究、纵向研究和跨区域研究提供了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了首个系统性的拉美右翼公民社会数据集（RAR Database），为后续实证研究和政策分析提供了可公开使用的数据基础。

title: A Leakage-Aware and Temporally Validated Framework for E-Commerce Campaign Decision Support: Channel Prioritization, Campaign Timing and Partner-Level Evidence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and MEF University

detail.title: A Leakage-Aware and Temporally Validated Framework for E-Commerce Campaign Decision Support: Channel Prioritization, Campaign Timing and Partner-Level Evidence
detail.abstract: E-commerce campaign teams need decision-support evidence that is predictive, temporally robust and directly actionable. This study proposes a leakage-aware and temporally validated framework for e-commerce campaign response prediction, with emphasis on channel prioritization, campaign timing and partner-level monitoring. The analysis uses 204,684 campaign-level observations from 29 U.S.-based partners collected between 1 January 2023 and 27 March 2026. The primary target, high_conversion, is defined with a median conversion-rate threshold, producing a balanced benchmark of 102,342 positive and 102,342 negative observations. Conversion-defining variables are excluded from the predictive feature set, and pre-campaign, in-campaign and post-campaign use modes are separated to clarify feature availability and leakage boundaries. The framework combines nonparametric behavioral testing, Random Forest and XGBoost modeling, expanding-window temporal validation, row-level and partner-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals, feature-importance analysis, SHAP-based interpretation and reproducible text grouping. The results show non-normal campaign metrics and statistically reliable but mostly small seasonal, weekday/weekend and channel differences. Mobile push notifications have the highest median conversion rate and remain positively associated with high_conversion after observed controls, but this finding is treated as associational. XGBoost improves holdout accuracy from 0.733 to 0.780 and PR-AUC from 0.8503 to 0.8939 relative to Random Forest, while reducing false positives, false negatives and total errors. The study contributes a validation protocol that links leakage-aware model evaluation with actionable e-commerce decisions about channels, timing and partner-specific monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个具有泄漏感知和时间验证的电商活动响应预测框架，使用20多万条合作伙伴级数据，结合随机森林和XGBoost模型，通过扩展窗口时间验证和SHAP解释等方法，实现了渠道优先级、活动时机和合作伙伴级监控的决策支持。XGBoost相比随机森林将准确率从0.733提升至0.780，PR-AUC从0.8503提升至0.8939。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个具有泄漏感知和时间稳健性的电商活动响应预测框架，以支持渠道优先级、活动时机和合作伙伴级监控等可操作决策？
AI.motivation: 电商活动团队需要具有预测性、时间稳健性和直接可操作性的决策支持证据，但现有研究在数据泄漏控制、时间验证和实际可操作性之间存在缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数行为检验、随机森林、XGBoost、扩展窗口时间验证、Bootstrap置信区间、特征重要性分析、SHAP解释、可复现文本分组。
AI.method: 使用204,684条来自29个美国合作伙伴的活动级数据（2023.1.1-2026.3.27），以中位数转化率阈值定义二分类目标变量high_conversion（平衡数据集）。排除转化定义变量以避免泄漏，区分活动前、中、后三种使用模式。采用非参数检验、随机森林和XGBoost建模、扩展窗口时间验证、行级和合作伙伴集群Bootstrap置信区间、SHAP解释等方法。
AI.findings: 活动指标呈非正态分布，季节、工作日/周末和渠道差异具有统计显著性但效应量较小。移动推送通知具有最高的中位数转化率，且在控制其他变量后仍与high_conversion正相关（视为关联性发现）。XGBoost相比随机森林将准确率从0.733提升至0.780，PR-AUC从0.8503提升至0.8939，同时减少了假阳性、假阴性和总错误数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将泄漏感知模型评估与可操作的电商决策（渠道、时机和合作伙伴级监控）相连接的时间验证协议，为电商活动预测中的方法严谨性提供了新标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商活动团队提供了关于渠道优先级（移动推送通知优先）、活动时机选择（季节性/周度效应）和合作伙伴级异常监控的可操作决策依据，以及一套可复现的预测建模框架。

title: Engineering Intelligent Industrial Ecosystems: Designing, Inhabiting and Sustaining AI-Driven Environments
affiliations: Technical University of Sofia, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and Technical University of Sofia

detail.title: Engineering Intelligent Industrial Ecosystems: Designing, Inhabiting and Sustaining AI-Driven Environments
detail.abstract: Existing AI lifecycle frameworks, including CRISP-DM, CRISP-ML(Q), and MLOps-based approaches, treat AI deployment as isolated instances, ignoring the ecosystem around it and the humans within it. This paper argues that making intelligent ecosystems work requires addressing three intertwined challenges simultaneously: designing the ecosystem in which AI operates, sustaining the AI reliably over time, and inhabiting the ecosystem in a human-centred way. We present an integrated framework grounded in three complementary, independently validated perspectives: an ecosystem engineering methodology for structuring governance, stakeholders, and capabilities (Design); a reference architecture and concept drift adaptation method for maintaining AI robustness in production environments (Sustain); and a human-system integration approach leveraging immersive technologies and cyber-physical-human systems (Inhabit). Drawing on AI-failure research, we show that the three dimensions are jointly necessary and directionally coupled, so that a weakness in one propagates to the others. The Design-Inhabit-Sustain (DIS) framework therefore complements existing lifecycle frameworks, supplying the ecosystem, human-integration, and robustness layers they leave underspecified. Each dimension is independently validated, and we outline the next steps toward integrated, end-to-end validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Design-Inhabit-Sustain (DIS)框架，认为让AI生态系统真正发挥作用需要同时解决三个相互交织的挑战：设计AI运作的生态系统、长期维持AI的可靠性、以及以人为中心的方式融入生态系统。该框架补充了现有AI生命周期模型在生态系统、人机集成和鲁棒性方面的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个同时解决生态系统设计、长期维护和人本融入三大挑战的AI部署框架？
AI.motivation: 现有AI生命周期框架（如CRISP-DM、CRISP-ML(Q)、MLOps）将AI部署视为孤立实例，忽略了AI运作的生态系统及其中的"人"的因素，导致实际部署中频繁出现系统失效问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三大互补理论视角：生态系统工程方法论（设计）、参考架构与概念漂移适应方法（维持）、沉浸式技术与网络-物理-人类系统的融合方法（融入）。三者之间存在方向性耦合关系。
AI.method: 基于AI失败研究的理论整合与框架构建，三个维度分别有独立的实证验证支持。
AI.findings: 设计、维持、融入三个维度必须同时满足，任一维度的薄弱都会传导至其他维度。现有生命周期框架在这三个维度上均存在规范不足的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DIS框架作为现有AI生命周期模型的补充，揭示了AI部署中三个关键维度之间的方向性耦合关系，为理解AI系统在现实生态系统中的失败提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统部署提供了可操作的整合框架，涵盖治理结构设计、概念漂移应对策略以及人机融合的沉浸式技术方案，帮助组织避免因忽视生态和人类因素而导致的AI部署失败。

title: Towards Digital Decarbonization: The BluePort Nexus as a Logistical Intelligence Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Towards Digital Decarbonization: The BluePort Nexus as a Logistical Intelligence Framework
detail.abstract: The maritime logistics sector faces urgent pressure to decarbonise , yet operational inefficiencies at the port-vessel interface remain a primary contributor to avoidable emissions. This paper introduces the BluePort Nexus, a digital-decarbonization architecture designed to synchronize port operations with maritime traffic flows through real-time logistical intelligence. By employing a digital-twin architecture, the Nexus optimizes the interface between port infrastructure and incoming vessels, significantly reducing idle times and energy expenditure. We examine the logistical dependencies within the Singapore-Rotterdam trade corridor to demonstrate how synchronized data flows act as a mechanism for carbon intensity reduction. The findings establish that digital intelligence is an essential component of sustainable maritime infrastructure, providing a scalable framework for port authorities to enhance operational efficiency while meeting stringent emission targets. This study contributes to the Blue Economy discourse by defining the nexus between administrative digital transformation and environmental performance in global supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为BluePort Nexus的数字-脱碳架构，通过数字孪生技术同步港口运营与船舶交通流，以减少港口-船舶接口处的可避免排放，并以新加坡-鹿特丹贸易走廊为例验证其效果。
AI.research_question: 数字智能如何通过同步港口运营与海上交通流来降低碳排放强度？
AI.motivation: 海事物流行业面临迫切的脱碳压力，而港口-船舶接口处的运营效率低下是可避免排放的主要来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字-脱碳架构、数字孪生、实时物流智能、蓝经济话语
AI.method: 提出BluePort Nexus数字-脱碳架构，采用数字孪生技术优化港口基础设施与到港船舶之间的接口，并以新加坡-鹿特丹贸易走廊为案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 同步数据流可作为碳强度降低的机制；数字智能是可持续海事基础设施的关键组成部分，可为港口当局提供可扩展的框架以提高运营效率并满足严格的排放目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 定义了行政数字化转型与全球供应链环境绩效之间的纽带，丰富了蓝经济话语体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为港口当局提供了一个可扩展的框架，通过实时物流智能同步港口运营与船舶交通流，显著减少闲置时间和能源消耗，助力实现脱碳目标。

title: Framework for Data Analytics Visualization Environment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Framework for Data Analytics Visualization Environment
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is playing an increasingly central role in industry, where it can support decision-making, improve productivity, and enable preventive maintenance, all of which can be decisive for a factory's competitiveness. However, effective AI adoption in industrial settings remains limited by the difficulty of setting up, using, and interpreting these technologies, a challenge compounded by the shortage of specialized personnel available to organizations, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises. AIOps and MLOps practices, combined with low-code/no-code development approaches, have emerged as key enablers for reducing this complexity and bringing AI closer to non-technical users. This paper presents the Data Analytics Visualization Environment (DAVE), a framework that lets users design AI workflows through a no-code interface while providing built-in AIOps and MLOps functionalities. DAVE organizes analytical tasks into reusable operators, connectors, transformers, and analytics, that users combine visually; these are automatically translated into Apache Airflow-compatible workflows, while MLflow handles model versioning and lifecycle management behind the scenes. The framework further supports external operators through human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interaction patterns, positioning it as an orchestration layer for heterogeneous AI ecosystems. DAVE's design and evolution are validated across four European research projects, VesselAI, i4Q, AI-DAPT, and MaaSAI, spanning the maritime, manufacturing, healthcare, robotics, and energy domains, demonstrating its applicability to diverse industrial contexts and its progressive maturation in response to real-world requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DAVE（数据分析和可视化环境）框架，通过无代码界面、AIOps/MLOps功能以及可复用算子，降低工业场景中AI应用的门槛，并通过四个欧洲研究项目验证了其跨行业适用性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过低代码/无代码框架结合AIOps与MLOps实践，降低工业AI应用的门槛，使其对非技术用户更友好？
AI.motivation: 工业AI应用潜力巨大，但受限于部署复杂、专业人才短缺等问题，中小企业尤为困难；现有AIOps/MLOps和低代码方法虽有助益，但缺乏整合性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIOps（AI运维）、MLOps（机器学习运维）、低代码/无代码开发、人机协同模式（Human-in-the-loop / Human-on-the-loop）。
AI.method: 提出DAVE框架：通过无代码可视化界面设计AI工作流，自动转换为Apache Airflow任务流程，使用MLflow管理模型版本与生命周期，支持外部算子与人工介入模式。验证方式为四个欧洲研究项目（VesselAI, i4Q, AI-DAPT, MaaSAI）的跨领域应用。
AI.findings: DAVE框架能够有效降低AI工作流的设计与部署难度；其算子结构支持跨领域复用；自动编排与版本管理提升了工业AI的可维护性；人机协同模式增强了系统灵活性；四个项目验证了其在航运、制造、医疗、机器人和能源领域的适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AIOps/MLOps理念嵌入无代码框架，提出"编排层"概念以统筹异构AI生态系统；发展了人机协同（human-in-the-loop / human-on-the-loop）在工业AI工作流中的具体实现方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非技术用户提供可视化AI工作流设计工具，降低工业AI应用门槛；通过可复用算子和自动部署机制，减少对专业AI人才的依赖，尤其惠及中小企业；跨行业验证表明框架具有较高的泛化性和实用价值。

title: Transparency Without Transformation? Digital Data Practices in Sustainable Shipping: A Systematic Review
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Transparency Without Transformation? Digital Data Practices in Sustainable Shipping: A Systematic Review
detail.abstract: Shipping faces growing pressures to decarbonize and digitalize. This systematic literature review synthesizes fragmented studies to understand how digitalization shapes maritime personnel’s operational data practices and the effects on environmental sustainability in shipping. Following PRISMA guidelines, qualitative thematic synthesis of peer-reviewed studies was conducted, supplemented by regulatory and industry gray literature. Three themes emerged: (1) digital decision-support systems and energy-efficient operations; (2) seafarer agency and autonomy in digital work environments; and (3) data infrastructure, competence, and institutional conditions shaping sustainable maritime operations. Results indicate digital tools can support fuel efficiency and emissions reduction, but effectiveness depends on contextual design, workflow integration, crew engagement, and organizational support. Seafarers value digital support, not digital control; existing energy-efficient behaviors are not structurally supported by organizational incentives. The evidence reveals that sustainable shipping depends less on technology availability than on the socio-technical arrangements governing operational data practices, exposing a risk of transparency without transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了数字化如何影响海事人员的运营数据实践及其对航运环境可持续性的影响。研究发现，数字化工具虽能支持燃油效率和减排，但效果取决于情境设计、工作流程整合、船员参与和组织支持。可持续航运更依赖于社会技术安排而非技术可用性，存在"透明无变革"的风险。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何塑造海事人员的运营数据实践，以及这些实践对航运环境可持续性产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 航运业面临脱碳和数字化的双重压力，但现有研究较为零散，缺乏系统整合。本文旨在系统梳理数字化对海事人员数据实践及其环境可持续性影响的已有研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论，强调数字化效果取决于技术、人员、组织和工作流程之间的互动关系。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南进行系统性文献综述，对同行评审研究进行定性主题综合，并辅以法规和行业灰色文献。
AI.findings: 三个主题：（1）数字决策支持系统与节能运行；（2）海员在数字工作环境中的自主性与能动性；（3）数据基础设施、能力与制度条件对可持续运营的影响。海员重视数字支持而非数字控制，现有节能行为缺乏组织激励的结构性支持。可持续航运更依赖于社会技术安排而非技术可用性，存在"透明无变革"的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字化与航运可持续性之间的社会技术机制，指出技术效果的中介条件（情境设计、工作整合、组织支持），挑战了技术决定论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航运企业和政策制定者提供建议：数字化应服务于海员而非控制海员；需建立支持节能行为的组织激励机制；关注数据实践的社会技术安排而非单纯引入技术。

title: The Inner Game of Hybrid Intelligence: A Mathematical Framework for Overcoming Mirage and Friction in Human-AI Teams

detail.title: The Inner Game of Hybrid Intelligence: A Mathematical Framework for Overcoming Mirage and Friction in Human-AI Teams
detail.abstract: Despite the theoretical complementary potential of human and artificial intelligence, hybrid teams frequently fail to outperform their solo counterparts. This paper proposes a novel mathematical framework to conceptualize this paradox, adapted from Timothy Gallwey's "Inner Game" equation (Performance = Potential-Interference) and integrated with Je rey Gray's Reinforcement Sensitivity Theory (BAS/BIS). We propose that E ective Human-AI Performance is a dynamic tension between synergistic potential and systemic interference, moderated by an integration coe icient (𝛼) and a friction coe icient (𝛽). Through a focused literature synthesis of 10 recent studies on human-AI collaboration, we demonstrate how trust miscalibration, audit costs, and workflow sequencing modulate these coe icients. We identify two primary collaborative failure modes: "Mirage Failure" (automation bias and overreliance driven by high 𝛼) and "Friction Freeze" (cognitive overload and algorithm aversion driven by high 𝛽). While the core variables of the equation are highly empirically supported, the neuro-behavioral coe icients remain theoretically plausible constructs requiring targeted empirical validation. We conclude with suggested refinements to the model and testable hypotheses for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个整合"内在游戏"方程与强化敏感性理论的新数学框架，用于解释人机混合团队为何常未能超越纯人类或纯AI团队的表现悖论。框架引入了协同潜能与系统干扰的动态张力，通过整合系数(α)和摩擦系数(β)加以调节，并识别了两种协作失败模式："幻象失败"（高α导致的自动化偏见）和"摩擦冻结"（高β导致的认知超载）。
AI.research_question: 人机混合团队为何频繁表现不如纯人类或纯AI团队？如何从理论上解释这一人机协作悖论？
AI.motivation: 尽管理论上人类与AI具有互补潜力，但实证中混合团队常表现不佳，现有理论框架缺乏对这一悖论的系统性数学化解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Timothy Gallwey的"内在游戏"方程（绩效=潜能-干扰）2. Jeffrey Gray的强化敏感性理论（BAS/BIS系统）3. 人机协作的整合系数(α)与摩擦系数(β)双系数模型
AI.method: 文献综合法：对10项近期人机协作研究进行聚焦式文献综述，分析信任校准偏差、审计成本和工作流排序对α和β系数的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 识别两种主要失败模式：高α驱动的"幻象失败"（自动化偏见与过度依赖）和高β驱动的"摩擦冻结"（认知超载与算法厌恶）2. 信任校准偏差、审计成本和工作流排序是调节α和β的关键因素3. 核心变量具有高度实证支持，但神经行为系数仍需定向实证验证
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将"内在游戏"方程与强化敏感性理论整合应用于人机协作领域2. 提出可量化的双系数（α和β）数学框架3. 系统化分类了两种协作失败模式，为后续理论发展提供基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为设计更有效的人机协作系统提供理论指导2. 帮助识别和预防团队协作中的"幻象失败"和"摩擦冻结"问题3. 提出可检验的假设，为未来实验研究提供方向

title: Agentic Proxies: Governance, Accountability, and the Architecture of a Trustworthy AI Economy [Working Draft -June 2026]
affiliations: Kindred Systems OS Ltd.

detail.title: Agentic Proxies: Governance, Accountability, and the Architecture of a Trustworthy AI Economy [Working Draft -June 2026]

declarations.funderStatement: Kindred Systems OS Ltd funded the research.

detail.abstract: Three claims organise this paper. First: the emerging accountability problem in AI is not human-to-AI interaction. It is AI-to-AI delegation-the transfer of authority, mandate, and responsibility across chains of autonomous agents that act at machine speed, across vendor boundaries, without continuous human involvement. Existing governance frameworks-identity systems, observability platforms, compliance APIs-establish who an agent claims to be and what it did. None establish whether a delegated action remained continuously authorised across a multi-agent workflow. That is the gap this paper addresses. Second: bounded delegation is the preferable design philosophy for AI systems acting consequentially on behalf of humans-not as a temporary concession to present-day limitations, but as an enduring principle. An AI agent operating under explicit, bounded, verifiable delegation is not a constrained version of a fully autonomous agent. It is a different and more trustworthy class of actor: one whose actions are attributable, whose authority is traceable, and whose failures are governable. We term this class the agentic proxy. Third: insurability emerges from accountability, not from model capability. Fully autonomous agents are structurally uninsurable because they satisfy none of the three conditions underwriters require-identifiable exposure, attributable causation, and verifiable governance. Agentic proxies satisfy all three by design. This creates the foundation for a viable AI insurance market, and makes the governance architecture described in this paper not merely a design preference but a commercial and regulatory requirement. The paper introduces a working definition of agentic proxies, establishes their six core properties, and distinguishes them from adjacent concepts. It presents the CTX Envelope as the architectural primitive for preserving accountability across agent handoffs, and argues that the attestation layer verifying these chains must be structurally independent of the entities producing them-for the same reason that audit firms, certificate authorities, and inter-bank messaging systems are independent. Through case studies spanning healthcare, financial services, legal workflows, and manufacturing, the framework is tested against real deployment challenges. The paper concludes by situating the agentic proxy model within the broader history of trust infrastructure-SWIFT, ACORD, TLS, SOC 2-arguing that AI requires the same institutional foundations that commerce, banking, payments, and the internet eventually required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI问责问题本质是AI对AI的委托（delegation），而非人机交互。作者主张"有限委托"（bounded delegation）应成为AI系统设计的持久原则，并提出"代理代理人"（agentic proxy）概念——一种行为可归因、权限可追溯、失败可治理的可信AI代理。文章设计了CTX信封作为跨代理工作流中维持问责的架构原语，并论证可保险性源于问责而非模型能力。通过医疗、金融、法律和制造业案例验证框架，并将其置于信任基础设施历史脉络中（SWIFT、TLS等）。
AI.research_question: 如何构建跨多AI代理链式委托场景下的问责机制？如何在AI系统设计中确保委托行为的持续授权可验证性？
AI.motivation: 现有治理框架（身份系统、可观测性平台、合规API）只能确定代理"是谁"和"做了什么"，但无法确定跨多代理工作流中的委托行为是否持续获得授权。这一"问责缺口"在当前AI代理快速自主化、去人化的趋势下愈发严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限委托（Bounded Delegation）哲学、代理代理人（Agentic Proxy）理论、问责作为可保险性基础的理论。
AI.method: 理论构建（定义代理代理人六大核心属性）、架构设计（CTX信封原语）、跨领域案例研究（医疗、金融服务、法律工作流、制造业）。
AI.findings: 1）AI问责的核心挑战是AI-to-AI链式委托的授权连续性；2）有限委托应是持久设计原则而非权宜之计；3）完全自主的AI代理在结构上不可保险，而代理代理人本质上满足保险三大条件（可识别风险暴露、可归因因果、可验证治理）；4）CTX信封可作为维持跨代理交接问责的架构原语；5）验证链条的证明层必须结构独立于产生它们的实体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"代理代理人"作为全新AI代理分类概念，区分于完全自主代理；建立"有限委托"作为持久设计原则的理论基础；论证问责与可保险性之间的结构性关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供CTX信封架构原语供工程实现；为AI保险市场提供设计基础；为监管框架提供设计参考；通过多行业案例验证框架的实操可行性。

title: Bridging Consumer Sentiment and Advertising Content Generation: A Retrieval-Augmented Pipeline for Aspect-Grounded Advertising
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bridging Consumer Sentiment and Advertising Content Generation: A Retrieval-Augmented Pipeline for Aspect-Grounded Advertising

keywords.keywords: Aspect-based sentiment analysisRetrieval-augmented generationCommunicative intent classificationMarketing content generationConsumer review analysisLarge language models

detail.abstract: E-commerce platforms accumulate vast volumes of consumer reviews that encode fine-grained,aspect-specific opinions rarely exploited by existing marketing-automation systems. Currentadvertising content generation approaches either collapse this richness into a single document-level polarity label or prompt large language models (LLMs) without any grounding mechanism,producing fluent but consumer-disconnected copy. This paper proposes and evaluates anautomated pipeline that converts consumer product reviews into two complementary marketingoutputs, a targeted advertisement and a structured five-section marketing strategy report, byintegrating four analytical components. A DeBERTa-v3 model fine-tuned on SemEval Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) benchmarks extracts aspect-sentiment pairs from 1,000verified Amazon reviews through a novel hybrid lexical-semantic detection gate, achieving a45.4% aspect-detection rate and recovering 33.4% of all detected aspects through semanticmatching alone, that is, from reviews containing no literal keyword match. Zero-shot BART-large-MNLI intent classification assigns a communicative intent to every review and derives adataset-level tone signal. A FAISS-based aspect-aware retrieval mechanism filters candidateevidence by identified aspect and sentiment polarity before semantic ranking, in contrastto standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which ranks by topic similarity alone.Marketing content is generated with Gemini 2.5 Flash and evaluated with an LLM-as-judgeprotocol across six quality, specificity, and alignment dimensions in a single-run pilot evaluationspanning three product categories. The proposed pipeline (Model C) substantially outperformsa no-analysis LLM baseline (Model A) and a standard semantic-RAG baseline (Model B)on every metric in this pilot: mean groundedness 7.33/10 versus 1.33/10 for both baselines,reassurance quality 9.33 versus 3.67 and 4.33, hallucination avoidance 8.33 versus 1.00 and1.33, and specificity 7.33 versus 2.00 and 1.33. Notably, the two baselines obtain numericallyidentical groundedness scores in this sample, suggesting that unfiltered semantic retrieval mayprovide no practical benefit over no retrieval at all for targeted complaint resolution, a patternconsistent across all three categories though not yet tested for statistical significance given thesmall sample. The pipeline generalises to an out-of-domain Yelp corpus with a comparable,if lower, detection rate, supporting its cross-domain applicability. These preliminary findingssuggest that aspect-aware retrieval, rather than retrieval per se, may be a necessary ingredient forconsumer-grounded marketing-content generation; we present this as a pilot study motivatinglarger-scale, statistically powered follow-up evaluation

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一个将消费者评论自动转化为定向广告和营销策略报告的管道，通过整合方面情感分析、意图分类、方面感知检索和LLM生成四个组件。在试点评估中，该管道在接地性、安慰质量、幻觉避免和特异性方面显著优于无分析基线和标准语义RAG基线，表明方面感知检索可能是消费者接地营销内容生成的必要条件。
AI.research_question: 如何将电商平台上的消费者评论自动转化为具有消费者接地性的定向广告和营销策略报告？
AI.motivation: 现有营销自动化系统未能充分利用消费者评论中细粒度、面向特定方面的情感信息；当前广告内容生成方法要么将丰富评论压缩为单一极性标签，要么直接使用LLM生成无接地机制的流畅但脱离消费者的文案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 方面级情感分析（ABSA）、零样本意图分类、基于FAISS的方面感知检索增强生成（Aspect-Aware RAG）、LLM-as-Judge评估协议。
AI.method: 集成四个组件：（1）基于DeBERTa-v3的ABSA模型（在SemEval基准上微调）提取方面-情感对；（2）BART-large-MNLI零样本意图分类为每条评论分配沟通意图；（3）FAISS方面感知检索，按方面和情感极性筛选候选证据后再进行语义排序；（4）Gemini 2.5 Flash生成营销内容。在1,000条Amazon评论和Yelp语料上评估。
AI.findings: 提出管道在接地性（7.33/10 vs 1.33/10）、安慰质量（9.33 vs 3.67和4.33）、幻觉避免（8.33 vs 1.00和1.33）和特异性（7.33 vs 2.00和1.33）上大幅超过两个基线；方面检测率45.4%，其中33.4%通过语义匹配恢复；两个基线的接地性得分相同，表明无过滤的语义检索对定向投诉解决可能无实际益处。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并初步验证了"方面感知检索是消费者接地营销内容生成的必要条件"这一论断，挑战了标准语义RAG在营销场景中的有效性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个端到端的自动化管道，可将消费者评论直接转化为接地、减少幻觉的定向广告和结构化营销策略报告，并展示了其跨领域适用性（从Amazon评论推广到Yelp语料）。

title: How customer-to-customer simulation-based training enhances customer-to-customer interaction qualities and loyalty in MMORPG settings
affiliations: Hallym University

detail.title: How customer-to-customer simulation-based training enhances customer-to-customer interaction qualities and loyalty in MMORPG settings
detail.abstract: This study examines how customer-to-customer (C2C) simulation-based training enhances customer-to-customer interactions and loyalty in collectively interactive service settings, where C2C interactions drive value co-creation. Survey data from an MMORPG service context were analyzed using structural equation modeling for testing the hypotheses. Results show that C2C simulation-based training improves C2C interaction quality spanning friend-, neighboring customer-, and audience-interaction and strengthens customers’ loyalty intention through C2C participatory transfer. Managers of collectively interactive services can apply C2C simulation-based training to enhance C2C interaction quality via participatory transfer, thereby sustaining customer loyalty and long-term business performance. This research is the first to theorize and empirically examine a sequential effect from C2C simulation-based training through participatory transfer and interaction quality to loyalty, extending customer training and participation literature while offering service firms a practical lever for performance improvement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在集体互动服务场景中，顾客间模拟培训如何通过参与转移提升顾客间互动质量与忠诚度。基于MMORPG服务情境的调查数据，采用结构方程模型进行假设检验。结果表明，顾客间模拟培训能改善朋友型、邻客型和观众型三种互动质量，并通过顾客间参与转移增强忠诚意愿。
AI.research_question: 顾客间模拟培训如何影响顾客间互动质量与顾客忠诚度？其中介机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在集体互动服务场景中，顾客间互动是价值共创的核心驱动力，但现有研究缺乏对如何通过培训手段系统提升顾客间互动质量的探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 顾客培训理论、顾客参与理论、价值共创理论、顾客间互动理论
AI.method: 问卷调查法（MMORPG服务情境），结构方程模型（SEM）进行假设检验
AI.findings: (1) C2C模拟培训显著提升三种类型的C2C互动质量（朋友型、邻客型、观众型）；(2) C2C参与转移在其中发挥中介作用；(3) 互动质量的提升进一步增强了顾客的忠诚意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次理论化并实证检验了从C2C模拟培训→参与转移→互动质量→忠诚度的序列效应，拓展了顾客培训与参与文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为集体互动服务企业的管理者提供了通过C2C模拟培训提升顾客互动质量与忠诚度的可操作工具，有助于维持长期业务绩效。

title: Dressed for the Festival, Made for the Landfill: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding How Culturally Resonant Interface Design Accelerates Fast Fashion Consumption in India Amrita

detail.title: Dressed for the Festival, Made for the Landfill: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding How Culturally Resonant Interface Design Accelerates Fast Fashion Consumption in India Amrita

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that may have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and theoretical study. No human participants, patient data, or primary empirical data collection was involved. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: India's fashion e-commerce sector is among the world's fastest-growing, with the online fashion retail segment projected to expand at a compound annual growth rate of 24.2% between 2025 and 2032. Major Indian fashion platforms routinely deploy culturally resonant visual design, including festival imagery, regional craft motifs, handloom aesthetics, and artisan-adjacent language, as central drivers of seasonal consumption. This paper develops a conceptual framework for understanding how such design choices perform a double function: they accelerate fast fashion purchasing by anchoring it in cultural legitimacy, while simultaneously appropriating the sustainability signifiers of the craft traditions they visually invoke. Drawing on scholarship in human-computer interaction, design ethics, consumer behavior, and postcolonial cultural studies, as well as first-hand practice-based research in Indian craft documentation and festive retail design, this paper makes three connected theoretical claims. Indian festival retail interface design functions as a culturally amplified consumption accelerant, combining established dark-pattern mechanisms with emotional cultural legitimacy in ways that existing HCI literature has not examined together. Handloom and craft aesthetics are regularly extracted from their social and ecological contexts and redeployed as sustainability signals in campaigns that primarily sell industrially produced fast fashion. Sustainability programs appended to volume-consumption architectures are structurally incapable of addressing the harm that the core interface is designed to produce. The paper closes by proposing a research agenda for empirical work and directions for responsible design practice at the intersection of cultural heritage, e-commerce UX, and environmental accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示印度时尚电商平台如何通过节日视觉设计、手工艺美学等文化符号，在加速快时尚消费的同时挪用传统手工艺的可持续性意涵，并提出此类界面在结构上无法通过附加可持续项目来弥补其核心设计造成的环境伤害。
AI.research_question: 印度时尚电商平台的节日零售界面设计如何同时实现文化合法性的消费加速与手工艺可持续性符号的挪用？
AI.motivation: 印度时尚电商增长迅猛（2025-2032年复合增长率24.2%），平台普遍运用文化视觉设计驱动消费，但现有HCI文献未能将暗黑模式与情感文化合法性相结合进行考察，且缺乏对文化符号挪用与可持续性伪装的批判性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机交互（HCI）、设计伦理、消费者行为、后殖民文化研究
AI.method: 跨学科理论整合与第一手实践研究（印度手工艺文献记录及节日零售设计）
AI.findings: 1）节日零售界面设计是"文化放大的消费加速器"，结合了暗黑模式与情感文化合法性；2）手工艺美学被从其社会与生态语境中剥离，作为快时尚的可持续性信号；3）在大规模消费架构中附加可持续项目，在结构上无法弥补核心界面设计造成的伤害。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将暗黑模式与情感文化合法性结合起来分析电商界面设计；提出"文化放大的消费加速器"概念；揭示手工艺美学作为可持续性伪装的机制；论证附加可持续项目的结构性无效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化遗产、电商UX与环境问责交叉领域的负责任设计实践提出研究方向与经验研究议程。

title: Deep Learning in Data-Driven Marketing: A Systematic Review of Applications, Architectures, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
affiliations: University of Tabriz, Department of Computer Engineering and Halic University

detail.title: Deep Learning in Data-Driven Marketing: A Systematic Review of Applications, Architectures, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
detail.abstract: Deep learning has become a major analytical foundation for modern marketing by enabling automated representation learning, nonlinear pattern discovery, and large-scale prediction from heterogeneous customer, textual, visual, behavioral, and transactional data. This study presents a systematic review of deep learning applications in marketing, synthesizing evidence from 120 studies published between 2015 and 2026. The review examines how deep learning architectures, including convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory networks, autoencoders, graph neural networks, generative adversarial networks, reinforcement learning models, and transformer-based approaches, have been applied across major marketing domains. These domains include sentiment analysis, personalized recommendation, targeted advertising, clickthrough-rate prediction, customer profiling, churn prediction, demand forecasting, e-commerce analytics, branding, social media marketing, and customer experience management. The findings show that deep learning models frequently outperform conventional machine learning methods, particularly in tasks involving unstructured data, sequential behavior, multimodal content, and complex customer interaction patterns. However, the review also identifies persistent barriers to practical adoption, including limited interpretability, privacy and ethical concerns, high computational cost, data dependency, model generalizability, and integration with business workflows. By organizing current evidence around applications, architectures, datasets, performance trends, and limitations, this review provides a structured understanding of the current state of deep learning in marketing. Finally, the study outlines a future research agenda emphasizing explainable deep learning, privacy-preserving marketing analytics, lightweight architectures, multimodal customer intelligence, and domain-specific models for responsible and effective data-driven marketing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了2015-2026年间120篇关于深度学习在营销领域应用的研究，总结了CNN、RNN、LSTM、GAN、GNN、强化学习及Transformer等架构在情感分析、推荐系统、广告投放、客户画像、流失预测等领域的应用，指出深度学习在非结构化数据和多模态任务中表现优异，但面临可解释性、隐私、计算成本等挑战，并提出了未来研究议程。
AI.research_question: 深度学习在营销领域中的应用现状如何？不同的深度学习架构（CNN、RNN、LSTM、自编码器、GNN、GAN、强化学习、Transformer）在哪些营销任务中表现出色？存在哪些阻碍实际采用的障碍？未来有哪些值得关注的研究方向？
AI.motivation: 深度学习已成为现代营销的重要分析基础，但缺乏对其在营销领域应用的系统性综述，特别是对不同架构、应用领域、性能趋势和限制因素的综合梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于系统综述方法，以深度学习架构类型（CNN、RNN、LSTM、自编码器、GNN、GAN、强化学习、Transformer）为技术维度，以营销应用领域（情感分析、个性化推荐、定向广告、客户流失预测、需求预测等）为业务维度，构建了技术-应用交叉分析框架。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，纳入2015至2026年间发表的120篇深度学习营销应用研究，对应用的架构类型、任务领域、数据集、性能趋势和局限性进行归纳与整合。
AI.findings: 1）深度学习模型在处理非结构化数据（文本、图像）、序列行为和多模态内容时经常优于传统机器学习；2）主要应用领域涵盖情感分析、推荐、广告、客户画像、流失预测、需求预测、电商分析、品牌建设、社交媒体营销及客户体验管理；3）实际采用中存在可解释性不足、隐私与伦理问题、计算成本高、数据依赖性大、泛化能力有限以及业务集成困难等障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为深度学习在营销领域的应用提供了系统性的知识地图，明确了不同架构与营销任务之间的匹配关系，识别了当前研究的空白和局限性，为后续理论发展奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业营销实践者提供了深度学习技术选型参考，指出了可解释深度学习、隐私保护分析、轻量架构、多模态客户智能及领域专用模型等未来方向，助力负责任且有效的数据驱动营销。

title: Optimizing for Citation, Not Clicks: The CITED Framework for Content Strategy in AI-Mediated Search

detail.title: Optimizing for Citation, Not Clicks: The CITED Framework for Content Strategy in AI-Mediated Search

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author developed the CITED framework described in this paper and is also the author of a related book on the topic. The author works in digital marketing and provides consulting services in search and content strategy, including generative engine optimization. These relationships could be perceived as influencing the presentation of the framework. To reduce this risk, all empirical claims in the paper are attributed to independent third-party research and assessed by evidence quality. The framework is also presented as a set of testable and falsifiable propositions that readers can evaluate independently. The author declares no other personal, professional, or financial relationships that could reasonably be viewed as influencing this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals and therefore did not require ethics approval or informed consent. The paper is a conceptual synthesis of published literature and publicly available secondary data. Any organizations, case studies, or examples included in the paper are fictional and used solely to illustrate how the framework can be applied. They do not represent real individuals or organizations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Generative engines answer a query by retrieving sources, combining them, and citing a few. This moves the unit of visibility from a ranked link to a citation inside an answer. In 2024, 58.5 per cent of United States Google searches ended with no click to the open web; by early 2026 the figure reached 68 per cent, and searches that trigger an AI Overview are zero-click about 83 per cent of the time. Keyword-era content strategy was built for a click economy that is contracting, while roughly 73 per cent of business buyers now use AI tools during research. This paper synthesizes about 50 academic and industry studies from 2024 to 2026 and the mechanism evidence behind them. Citation is decided in three steps: retrieval into a candidate set, selection within that set, and the brand's strength as an entity inside the model. Experimental work found that adding quotations, statistics, and citations raised a source's visibility in answers by 30 to 41 per cent, while keyword stuffing scored below the unedited baseline, and that lower-ranked pages gained most. Industry measurement found brand mentions correlate with AI citation about three times more strongly than backlinks, and that source overlap between two leading engines can be as low as 11 per cent. The paper consolidates these findings into a practitioner framework, CITED: Citation Surface, Information Architecture, Technical Foundation, Evidence-Rich Extraction, and Demand Capture. Each dimension is tied to one mechanism and one measurable signal, with a worked example and an implementation sequence. The paper defines the Citation Flywheel, states six falsifiable propositions, grades the evidence by quality, and sets out where the framework is least certain, including per-engine instability, measurement standards, and the value of a citation that produces no click.

AI.tldr: 当搜索引擎从链接排名转向生成式答案引用时，传统SEO失效。本文基于约50项研究，提出CITED框架（引用表面、信息架构、技术基础、证据丰富提取、需求捕获），发现引用、统计和外部来源可将源可见性提升30-41%，品牌提及与AI引用的相关性比反向链接强约3倍。
AI.research_question: 在生成式搜索引擎以引用而非链接为可见度单位的背景下，影响内容被AI引用（citation）的机制是什么？如何为从业者构建可操作的框架？
AI.motivation: 2024年58.5%的谷歌搜索无点击，2026年升至68%，AI概览搜索中约83%为零点击。关键词时代的点击经济正在萎缩，约73%的企业买家使用AI工具进行研究，亟需新的内容策略框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引用决策三步骤：检索进入候选集 → 候选集内选择 → 品牌作为实体在模型中的强度。CITED框架：Citation Surface（引用表面）、Information Architecture（信息架构）、Technical Foundation（技术基础）、Evidence-Rich Extraction（证据丰富提取）、Demand Capture（需求捕获）。
AI.method: 综合约50项2024-2026年学术与行业研究，包括实验研究和行业测量数据。
AI.findings: 添加引号、统计数据和外部引用可将源在答案中的可见性提高30-41%；关键词堆砌效果低于未编辑基线；低排名页面获益最大。品牌提及与AI引用的相关性比反向链接强约3倍；两大主流引擎的源重叠率低至11%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出CITED框架和Citation Flywheel（引用飞轮）概念；提出六个可证伪命题；按证据质量分级并明确框架的不确定区域（引擎间不稳定性、测量标准、无点击引用价值）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供五个可操作维度，每个维度对应一种机制和一个可测量信号，附带具体示例和实施顺序。

title: The Transformation of Service Centers: A Reviewed Analysis of AI's Intelligence Impact and Evolving Landscape

detail.title: The Transformation of Service Centers: A Reviewed Analysis of AI's Intelligence Impact and Evolving Landscape

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on service centers, analyzing the technological advancements driving this transformation and the changes in operational paradigms. We explore the core AI technologies, including Generative AI, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI-driven analytics, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), and their specific applications within customer service. Furthermore, this analysis explores operational transformations, including the shift toward the "Intelligent Contact Center," agent augmentation, proactive service delivery, and enhanced knowledge management. Finally, we address AI adoption's strategic considerations, including customer experience, workforce transformation, data privacy, and return on investment (ROI). This analysis provides a comprehensive overview of the evolution of AI-driven service centers' current and future trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能（包括生成式AI、RPA、AI驱动分析、NLP等）如何推动服务中心向"智能联络中心"转型，分析了运营范式变化（如座席增强、主动服务、知识管理）以及战略考量（客户体验、劳动力转型、数据隐私、ROI），为AI驱动服务中心的当前与未来发展提供了全面概述。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响服务中心的技术驱动变革与运营范式转变？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展，服务中心面临从传统模式向智能化转型的迫切需求，但缺乏对该领域技术应用、运营变革与战略考量的系统性整合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术驱动变革理论；服务中心运营范式理论；AI采纳与战略管理框架。
AI.method: 综述分析（Comprehensive overview），通过对生成式AI、RPA、NLP等核心技术及其在客户服务中应用的系统梳理，结合运营变革与战略考量进行多维度分析。
AI.findings: AI通过生成式AI、RPA、AI驱动分析和NLP等核心技术推动服务中心向"智能联络中心"转型；运营上呈现座席增强、主动服务交付、知识管理优化等变革；战略上需平衡客户体验、劳动力转型、数据隐私与ROI等关键议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了AI技术在服务中心的多维度应用与影响，构建了从技术应用到运营变革再到战略考量的分析框架，弥补了该领域缺乏全景式综述的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务行业管理者提供了AI技术选型、运营模式转型、以及客户体验、数据隐私与投资回报等战略决策的实践指导与参考框架。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the strategic utility of cross-border e-commerce networks as institutional riskmitigation channels for Indian Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) navigating geopolitical conflicts and weaponized maritime corridors. Utilizing a secondary-data-driven macro-logistical analysis framework, the research triangulates shipping metrics from the Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI) with institutional performance registries from the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) and NITI Aayog. The empirical findings reveal that intense maritime chokepoint instabilities near West Asian corridors introduced an 18-to-22-day route delay deviation, triggering a 2.4-fold multiplier spike in ocean freight rates and an unsustainable 45-day working capital freeze for traditional small-scale exporters. Conversely, a sweeping 72% majority of resilient firms effectively bypassed ocean blockades by executing a rapid modal shift to express air-cargo distribution, while 16% utilized platform-mediated international fulfilment warehousing (such as Fulfilled by Amazon-FBA) to preposition destination market inventories ahead of conflict shocks. While alternative digital pipelines exposed micro-merchants to a 42% average overhead expense inflation, the study highlights that the Government of India's newly deployed ₹497 crore RELIEF (Resilience & Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation) scheme effectively provided a 50% partial freight reimbursement cushion to secure their thin profit margins. Ultimately, the paper demonstrates that combining cross-border digital platforms with calibrated public fiscal buffers successfully transforms fragile, centralized physical supply pipelines into resilient, data-driven digital trade corridors.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了跨境电子商务网络作为印度中小微企业应对地缘政治冲突和海上航线武器化风险的制度性缓释渠道的战略效用。研究发现，海上咽喉要道不稳定导致传统出口商面临18-22天路线延误、2.4倍运费飙升及45天营运资金冻结；而72%的韧性企业通过转向空运，16%利用平台化国际履约仓储成功规避封锁。尽管数字渠道使微型商户平均管理费用膨胀42%，但印度政府新部署的49.7亿卢比RELIEF计划提供了50%的部分运费补贴以保障其微薄利润。论文证明，跨境数字平台与公共财政缓冲相结合，能成功将脆弱、集中的实体供应链转化为韧性、数据驱动的数字贸易走廊。
AI.research_question: 跨境电子商务网络能否作为印度中小微企业应对地缘政治冲突和海上航线武器化风险的制度性风险缓释渠道？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突导致海上咽喉要道（如西亚走廊）不稳定，严重威胁依赖传统海运的印度中小微出口企业的供应链安全，亟需探索替代性数字贸易通道的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度风险缓释理论、供应链韧性理论、数字平台经济学
AI.method: 采用二手数据驱动的宏观物流分析框架，三角验证上海集装箱运价指数（SCFI）、印度外贸总局（DGFT）和NITI Aayog的制度绩效登记数据。
AI.findings: 1）海上咽喉要道不稳定导致18-22天路线延误、2.4倍运费飙升及45天营运资金冻结；2）72%的韧性企业转向空运，16%利用FBA等平台化仓储前置库存；3）数字渠道使微型商户管理费用平均膨胀42%；4）印度RELIEF计划（49.7亿卢比）提供50%运费补贴有效保障利润空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度风险缓释理论拓展至跨境电子商务领域，揭示了数字平台与公共财政缓冲相结合如何将脆弱的实体供应链转化为韧性数字贸易走廊的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及新兴经济体中小微企业提供了应对地缘政治供应链风险的实操路径（空运转移+平台仓储），也为政策制定者设计补贴计划（如RELIEF方案）提供了实证依据。

title: The Safe-Debt Laffer Curve
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Safe-Debt Laffer Curve
detail.abstract: Government debt is often treated as the canonical safe asset, but its safety depends on more than sovereign solvency. This paper develops a theory in which safe government-debt claims are produced jointly by a solvent fiscal authority and a financial system that absorbs rollover risk. The government compensates that service through an excess yield on its debt; households receive the safe return net of the rollover-insurance premium. As the debt stock rises, rollover exposure rises relative to financial capacity, and the excess yield required to preserve safety increases. In steady state, this safety-production cost is financed through a lower primary deficit. At low debt levels, the direct wealth effect of additional insured debt dominates this fiscal adjustment. At high debt levels, the required fiscal adjustment dominates, so additional debt reduces aggregate demand and lowers the equilibrium safe rate. The mechanism generates a safe-debt Laffer curve for both aggregate demand and the safe interest rate. The rollover-insurance premium continues to rise with debt even where the equilibrium safe rate turns down. Financial capacity expands fiscal capacity (the peak of the safe-debt Laffer curve), higher debt strains financial capacity, and scarce rollover-insurance capacity tilts optimal debt management toward longer maturity despite the associated term-premium compensation. Preliminary diagnostic calculations place the United States close to the peak of the safe-debt Laffer curve.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个政府债务安全性的理论模型，指出政府债务的安全性不仅依赖于主权偿付能力，还依赖于金融系统吸收展期风险的能力。随着债务规模上升，展期风险暴露超过金融容量，维持安全性所需的超额收益率上升，形成安全债务的拉弗曲线。美国当前接近该曲线峰值。
AI.research_question: 政府债务的安全性如何受到金融系统吸收展期风险能力的影响？债务规模对安全利率、总需求和财政空间有何动态影响？
AI.motivation: 传统理论将政府债务视为无风险资产，但忽视了金融系统在维持债务安全性中的关键作用。本文旨在揭示财政当局与金融系统联合生产安全债务的机制，以及债务规模扩张如何通过展期风险渠道影响宏观均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全债务联合生产理论：偿付能力充足的财政当局与吸收展期风险的金融系统共同生产安全政府债务；展期保险溢价机制；安全债务拉弗曲线；财政容量与金融容量的互动关系。
AI.method: 理论建模与稳态分析，辅以对美国数据的初步诊断性计算。
AI.findings: （1）政府债务的安全性需要财政偿付能力与金融展期风险吸收能力联合保障；（2）债务上升→展期风险暴露超过金融容量→所需超额收益率上升→安全债务存在拉弗曲线（总需求和安全利率均存在峰值）；（3）低债务水平时财富效应主导，高债务水平时财政调整效应主导；（4）展期保险溢价随债务持续上升，即使安全利率已开始下降；（5）金融容量扩张财政容量，债务增加挤压金融容量；（6）展期保险容量稀缺使最优债务管理偏向长期限；（7）美国接近安全债务拉弗曲线峰值。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出安全债务的联合生产理论，将金融系统展期风险吸收能力纳入政府债务安全性分析；（2）揭示债务规模通过展期风险渠道影响安全利率和总需求的新机制；（3）提出安全债务拉弗曲线概念，刻画财政容量与金融容量的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为评估政府债务可持续性提供新视角——不仅要看偿付能力，还要看金融系统吸收展期风险的能力；（2）为最优债务期限管理提供理论指导——展期保险容量稀缺时应偏向长期债务；（3）对美国债务水平发出的政策警示——已接近安全债务拉弗曲线峰值，进一步扩大债务可能适得其反。

title: Cricket's Carbon Accountability Gap: An ESG Disclosure Assessment of the Indian Premier League

detail.title: Cricket's Carbon Accountability Gap: An ESG Disclosure Assessment of the Indian Premier League
detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper presents the first GHG Protocol-based disclosure assessment of a major cricket league, responding to published calls for interdisciplinary accountability research in sport (France et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2026). The Indian Premier League (IPL), the world's most valuable cricket property with revenue exceeding INR 18,700 crore and brand valuation above USD 16 billion, operates entirely outside India's corporate environmental disclosure architecture. Design/methodology/approach: A mixed-methods design employs four components: (a) comparative disclosure analysis scoring the IPL against Lord's Cricket Ground (MCC), the English Premier League (EPL), Cricket Australia, and the International Olympic Committee (IOC) across 12 GHG Protocol categories; (b) bottom-up carbon estimation using publicly available data and established peer-reviewed methodologies; (c) green claims assessment of five IPL environmental claims against the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (2024/825), PAS 2060, and ISO 14024; and (d) regulatory-legal document analysis of National Green Tribunal orders and BCCI compliance records. Findings: The IPL scores 1 out of 12 on GHG Protocol disclosure categories, compared with 12 for Lord's MCC and the IOC, 10 for the EPL, and 3 for Cricket Australia. A partial carbon floor estimate covering team travel, stadium electricity, and match-day waste yields 13,000-20,000 tCO2e per season. The IPL's most visible green initiative, the Green Dot Ball, offsets less than 1 percent of the estimated total footprint. Three of five environmental claims fail international verification standards. Environmental initiatives correlate temporally with National Green Tribunal enforcement orders rather than voluntary commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次基于GHG Protocol对印度板球超级联赛（IPL）进行披露评估。研究发现IPL在12个温室气体披露类别中仅得1分（满分12分），每赛季碳排放约13,000-20,000吨CO2e，其最显著的"绿点球"计划仅抵消不到1%的碳足迹，且五个环保声明中有三个未通过国际验证标准。IPL的环保行动更多与监管执法相关，而非自愿承诺。
AI.research_question: 印度板球超级联赛（IPL）的温室气体排放披露水平如何？其环境声明的可信度如何？IPL的环保行动是出于自愿承诺还是外部监管压力？
AI.motivation: 体育行业对环境有重大影响（旅行、场馆运营、供应链等），但学界对体育组织的环境问责研究不足。IPL作为全球最具价值的板球赛事，完全不受印度企业环境披露制度约束，成为检验体育组织环境透明度的典型案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: GHG Protocol温室气体核算体系；欧盟《赋能消费者指令》（2024/825）、PAS 2060碳中和标准、ISO 14024生态标签标准；体育环境问责与跨学科体育会计研究。
AI.method: 混合方法设计，包含四个部分：(a) 比较披露分析——将IPL与Lord's板球场、英超联赛、澳大利亚板球协会、国际奥委会在12个GHG Protocol类别上对比评分；(b) 自下而上的碳排放估算——利用公开数据和同行评审方法；(c) 绿色声明评估——对IPL五个环境声明依据欧盟指令和标准进行验证；(d) 监管法律文件分析——审查国家绿色法庭命令和BCCI合规记录。
AI.findings: (1) IPL在12个GHG Protocol披露类别中仅得1分，远低于Lord's和IOC（12分）、EPL（10分），仅高于澳大利亚板球协会（3分）；(2) 部分碳估算显示每赛季13,000-20,000吨CO2e；(3) "绿点球"计划仅抵消不到1%的碳足迹；(4) 五个环境声明中三个未通过国际验证标准；(5) 环保行动时间上与国家绿色法庭执法令相关，而非自愿承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 将GHG Protocol框架首次应用于板球联赛披露评估；将体育环境问责研究扩展到新兴经济体的大型体育赛事；证实了监管压力而非自愿承诺驱动环境行动的理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了IPL在环境披露上的严重不足，为监管机构（印度国家绿色法庭）提供实证依据；为体育组织制定标准化碳披露框架提供基准；警示消费者和赞助商需审慎看待体育赛事的"绿色"声明。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the strategic utility of cross-border e-commerce networks as institutional riskmitigation channels for Indian Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) navigating geopolitical conflicts and weaponized maritime corridors. Utilizing a secondary-data-driven macro-logistical analysis framework, the research triangulates shipping metrics from the Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI) with institutional performance registries from the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) [DGFT Trade Finance Study Report] and NITI Aayog [NITI Aayog]. The empirical findings reveal that intense maritime chokepoint instabilities near West Asian corridors introduced an 18-to-22-day route delay deviation, triggering a 2.4-fold multiplier spike in ocean freight rates and an unsustainable 45-day working capital freeze for traditional small-scale exporters [DGFT Trade Finance Study Report, Notteboom]. Conversely, a sweeping 72% majority of resilient firms effectively bypassed ocean blockades by executing a rapid modal shift to express air-cargo distribution, while 16% utilized platform-mediated international fulfilment warehousing (such as Fulfilled by Amazon-FBA) to preposition destination market inventories ahead of conflict shocks [India SME Forum, Qi]. While alternative digital pipelines exposed micro-merchants to a 42% average overhead expense inflation, the study highlights that the Government of India's newly deployed ₹497 crore RELIEF scheme effectively provided a 50% partial freight reimbursement cushion to secure their thin profit margins [India SME Forum, PIB 2026]. Ultimately, the paper demonstrates that combining cross-border digital platforms with calibrated public fiscal buffers successfully transforms fragile, centralized physical supply pipelines into resilient, data-driven digital trade corridors [DGFT Trade Finance Study Report, NITI Aayog].

AI.tldr: 本文研究了跨境电子商务网络如何作为制度性风险缓释渠道，帮助印度中小微企业在 geopolitical 冲突和海上通道武器化背景下实现贸易韧性。研究发现，72%的韧性企业通过转向航空快递、16%利用海外仓前置库存成功规避海运中断，但数字化渠道使微型商家平均运营成本上升42%。印度政府497亿卢比的RELIEF计划提供50%运费补贴，有效保障了企业薄利。
AI.research_question: 跨境电子商务网络能否作为制度性风险缓释渠道，帮助印度中小微企业应对地缘政治冲突和海上通道武器化带来的贸易中断风险？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突导致西亚走廊海上咽喉点不稳定，给依赖传统海运的印度中小微企业带来严重冲击（航线延误18-22天、运费上涨2.4倍、营运资金冻结45天），亟需探索替代性的数字化贸易通道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨境电子商务网络作为制度性风险缓释机制、数字贸易走廊理论、供应链韧性理论、公共财政缓冲与数字平台协同效应。
AI.method: 基于二手数据的宏观物流分析框架，三角验证上海集装箱运价指数（SCFI）、印度外贸总局（DGFT）贸易融资研究报告及NITI Aayog的制度绩效登记数据。
AI.findings: （1）海运中断导致18-22天航线延误、2.4倍运费飙升及45天营运资金冻结；（2）72%韧性企业转向航空快递、16%使用平台海外仓（如FBA）；（3）数字渠道使微型商家运营成本平均上升42%；（4）印度RELIEF计划（497亿卢比）提供50%运费补贴，有效保护企业利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨境数字平台与公共财政缓冲协同作用的分析框架，将数字贸易网络概念化为制度性风险缓释机制，拓展了供应链韧性理论在中小微企业跨境贸易中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及新兴经济体政策制定者提供了将数字平台与财政补贴工具结合以增强中小微企业贸易韧性的政策路径，验证了RELIEF计划等公共干预措施的有效性。

title: A New Forward-looking Stable Paretian Discrete Time Structure for the modeling of an Optimal Stopping Time
affiliations: FISK University

detail.title: A New Forward-looking Stable Paretian Discrete Time Structure for the modeling of an Optimal Stopping Time
detail.abstract: This study infers a new structure (`the structure') for the modeling of an optimal stopping time, τ, in which τ is solely a function of the anticipated future pace, ρ_{j,0}, with which the spot price, S, of an asset, j, is anticipated to change, such that (suppressing the subscript j), it facilitates some `rational target return (rtr)', r_{τ}(ρ₀)=S_{τ}/S₀≠1 in the future. Let w denote the writer, and b, the buyer of an option contract. Also, let ς denote the growth rate of an asset's cash flows. Rather than σ, which is a backward-looking parameter, it is the combination of, [ρ_{b}≠ρ_{w}]→[τ_{b}≠τ_{w}] and the strict preference (≻) structure, [ς>0]≻[ς≤0], that support the rationality of the simultaneous positive demand for either a call or a put option contract. Antecedently, put options are most robustly priced only in the context of an imposition of put-call parity. The resulting structure for the pricing of call options, which is directly spanned by the modeling of τ, consists of a `pace risk' (ρ_{b}-ρ_{w}) parameter that is explicitly conditioned on, as opposed to additive to a jump parameter; rather robustly, the said structure explicitly embeds the Black-Scholes option pricing structure as a special case. Relatedly, other than a single-period discount factor, the price of an American option endogenously embeds the price of a corresponding European option, but not vice versa. Whereas a stable Paretian process that is parametrically specified, as such, backward-looking, is expected to have a characteristic exponent, α satisfying, 0<α<2, newly S is shown to be spanned by a Structurally-specified Forward-looking Stable Paretian Process (SSP) with a newly inferred characteristic exponent, α(ssp)=0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于前瞻性预期价格变化速率（ρ）来建模最优停时τ的新框架，推导出"理性目标收益率"（rtr）结构，并以此重新解释期权定价。研究发现，买卖双方对ρ的差异导致停时不同，结合现金流增长率ς的正负偏好，可同时支持看涨和看跌期权的正需求。该结构将Black-Scholes模型作为特例，并引入了一种新的前瞻性稳定帕累托过程（SSP），其特征指数α(ssp)=0，区别于传统后顾性模型中的0<α<2。
AI.research_question: 如何基于前瞻性的预期价格变化速率（ρ）来构建最优停时τ，并以此推导出新的期权定价结构？
AI.motivation: 传统期权定价模型（如Black-Scholes）使用后顾性参数σ（波动率），无法充分捕捉市场参与者的前瞻性预期。本文试图通过引入前瞻性的"预期价格变化速率"ρ来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优停时理论；理性目标收益率（rtr）；前瞻性稳定帕累托过程（SSP）；严格偏好结构（≻）
AI.method: 数学推导与理论建模。通过构建ρ与τ的函数关系，推导期权定价的新结构，并将Black-Scholes模型作为特例嵌套其中。
AI.findings: 1. 买卖双方对ρ的认知差异（ρ_b≠ρ_w）导致最优停时不同（τ_b≠τ_w）；2. 现金流增长率ς的正负偏好（ς>0≻ς≤0）支持看涨和看跌期权的正需求；3. 看跌期权定价需依赖看跌-看涨平价关系；4. 新结构中的"速度风险"参数（ρ_b-ρ_w）是显式条件化的；5. 美式期权价格内嵌欧式期权价格，反之不成立；6. 标的资产价格S服从特征指数α(ssp)=0的前瞻性稳定帕累托过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于前瞻性预期速度的最优停时新范式；2. 推导出Black-Scholes模型作为特例的更一般化期权定价结构；3. 发现了特征指数α=0的新型稳定帕累托过程（SSP）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为期权定价提供了新的理论框架，可能提高定价精度；2. 明确了美式与欧式期权价格之间的非对称嵌入关系；3. 对风险管理中前瞻性参数的选择具有指导意义。

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建历史指数数据库（公元33-1990年），以格鲁吉亚教会为例，实证检验了"代理资本历史指数测度"理论框架，发现知识资本、制度自主性、外部认可和灾后恢复能力共同积累，是制度长期生产力与地位的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 制度长期生产力与地位是否仅源自正式结构？知识积累、代理行动、外部认可等非正式因素如何共同塑造制度韧性？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统制度经济学仅关注正式结构的局限，探索历史制度中无形资本（知识、合法性、代理行动）的长期作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理资本理论、知识资本理论、制度经济学、历史制度主义——将知识积累、代理能动性、外部认可视为长期生产性资产。
AI.method: 作者自建历史指数编码数据集（33-1990年），对历史事件、寺院中心、圣徒文本等按0-100评分，构建12个指数变量。使用描述统计、相关分析、主成分分析、HAC-OLS回归、交互效应、门槛效应、岭回归、一阶差分事件回归等计量模型。
